- Proactively seeks opportunities to identify and recommend changes to existing system applications to enable integration of emerging technologies by piloting Proof of Concepts 

Customer Focus



- Ensures that business continually responds to changing the needs of customer
- Reviews and revises the customer segmentation strategy periodically to proactively meet their needs
- Allocates time and resources to new segments and fosters new product / service development proactively
- Drives a culture of service across the organization through own words and actions
- Acts as the Business partner for the customer and owns the success / failure of the customer

Teamwork & Collaboration



- Provides requisite authority, resources & support for the team to function & deliver
- Breaks down barriers (structural, functional, cultural) between teams, facilitating the sharing of expertise and resources
- Brings multiple stakeholders, both internal and external, to resolve issues in organization interest
- Demonstrates collaboration by proactively looking for opportunities for jointly working with different Businesses of the Group
- Listens actively to every peer, collaborates with them and makes them feel valued and important
- Commands respect and credibility from colleagues/ peers-both internal and external
- Encourages and assist others to develop people networks
- Build long term relationships across a wide spectrum inside and outside the organization and leverages them, when required, to benefit the organization

Technology Digital Strategy Formulation



- Leverages understanding of business and IT goals to provide input to the IT strategy
- Conducts feasibility studies to outline risks and issues associated with proposed technology solutions
- Escalates risks / benefits to though leader for further consideration before going forward with strategy changes and improvements

Demand Management



- Leverages relationships with business stakeholders to promote usage of new technologies
- Oversees expectations management of each unit to ensure that business needs are being met
- Follows user trends and determine gaps that exist between services / application currently utilized as the needs that are presented

Strategic Vendor Selection & Management



- Participate in larger supplier / partner selection, assists in setting, selection criteria and potential suppliers’ evaluation
- Establishes supplier / partner relationship governance and reviews performance against defined SLAs
- Raises service improvements when needed, manages issue and resolve disputes
- Develops plans for specific business initiatives with vendors / business partners
- Ensures full benefits to organization and IT are realized from third party agreements
- Establishes relationship parameters, cost and scope through a clear statement of work

Setting up frameworks of standard & procedures



- Understand project time frame, team, complexity, risk and resources
- Sets up framework of standards and procedures
- Visualizing trends during sprints 
- Direct team to allocate time to the tasks where their expertise makes a difference
- To facilitate the team if there is any development blockages
- Prioritise activities for meeting timelines

Agile Methodology adoption



- Reviews all tasks within each Agile phase to ensure overall quality and accuracy
- Identifies process improvements and implements solutions in Agile methodology

Product Design and Development



- Manages multiple product portfolios
- Design product testing policies and processes
- Oversees Multiple product releases
- Track the progress of the project and tasks related to them
- Mitigate risks, increase members productivity levels 
- Keep business structure and other stakeholders updated on the work status on regular intervals

Requirement Gathering & Analysis (Understand client requirements to deliver right solutions)



- Examines the entire business application from workflow and an end user perspective
- Reviews business requirements from multiple user areas to ensure compatibility, Mediates for gaps, conflicts or inconsistencies across requirements
- Implements new processes and tolls to gather requirements
- Identifies all points of contact from the system perspective and communicates with relevant stakeholders
- Identifies impact of proposed requirements and provides guidance around process improvement opportunities
- Anticipates future requirements and customer needs, impacting the customer journey to enhance product and service offering and omni channel presence for different personas
- Ensure sign off from operations/ treasury/ finance on the requirement specifications

Solution Design



- Integrates functional design with overall architecture to support user requirements
- Determines data and process distribution in a way that balances functionality with technical feasibility
- Estimates solution cost, resource consumption and response time
- Assesses the feasibility of an application for a given technical architecture

Change Management



- Establishes a process that ensures the coherence of system objects and their relationship when the system is deployed
- Establishes process with lines of business to monitor and track change
- Ensure that known issues are documented and highlighted appropriately
- Manage JIRA Sprints and deliveries for TRM module
- Ensure JIRA process for all change requests for TRM Module

Incident & Problem Management (Application)



- Assists in the development of policies, procedures and techniques in order to minimize future incident / problem occurrence
- Implements applications / tools to maximize system integrity
- Ensures that appropriate action is taken to investigate and resolve problems and documents within the relevant reporting system
- Coordinates the implementation of agreed remedies and preventative measures

Service Level Management



- Makes recommendations for Service level Improvement and executes on recommendations to improve
- Develops and establishes new service levels
- Measures service level improvements against identified benchmarks and key performance indicators
- Resolves issues that disrupt operations
- Monitors trends on SLA compliance overtime and Generates actionable insights
- Identifies any outliers in terms of SLS compliance

Planning & Budgeting



- Knowledge of forecasting / budgeting tools and techniques
- Understands the inputs required to produce an accurate budgetary estimate
- Analyses reports and provides summary to leadership

Contract Management



- Operates within unit policy for vendor management
- Applies the fundamentals of contract formulation when working with procurement to draw up an individual vendor or business partner agreement
- Monitors vendor / business partner performance against contractual terms and conditions
- Seeks feedback and performs actions to improve relationship

Miscellaneous



- Support in handling audits and close observations shared by coordinating with stakeholders
- Ensure DR, health checks and Business continuity Plan is performed as per process

Reports



- Responsible for analyzing data and generating detailed reports which focus on relevant development metrics and KPI’s, focusing on the accomplished, planned and blocked tasks
- Status of projects currently underway and reporting as per frequency

Project Management



- Ensure quality & timelines are adhered to for all projects.
- Develop detailed Project plans 
- Monitor adherence to plans to ensure timeliness of projects
- Review and ensure desired quality of output

title: Group Product Manager - Payments | India [Head of Product, India]
descriptionHtml:
This is Adyen

Adyen provides payments, data, and financial products in a single solution for customers like Meta, Uber, H&M, and Microsoft - making us the financial technology platform of choice. At Adyen, everything we do is engineered for ambition.

For our teams, we create an environment with opportunities for our people to succeed, backed by the culture and support to ensure they are enabled to truly own their careers. We are motivated individuals who tackle unique technical challenges at scale and solve them as a team. Together, we deliver innovative and ethical solutions that help businesses achieve their ambitions faster.

Group Product Manager, Adyen India

As the Group Product Manager for India, you will be a pivotal member of the Adyen India Leadership Team. You will define and execute the product strategy for one of Adyen’s highest-growth regions, ensuring our merchants can expand their reach through locally preferred and innovative payment methods.

This role sits within the global Payments Group. You will collaborate closely with the India Country Head, the Head of Engineering, and global product groups to build the payment engine of the future. You are not just a strategist; you act as the external face of Adyen’s holistic product innovation, engaging with regulators, industry bodies, and C-level executives at the leading merchants to shape the future of the Indian fintech landscape.

What You Will Do

  • Formulate and lead a strategic vision that balances technical acquiring capabilities (eg. Cards, UPI) with the end-to-end merchant experience, ensuring our solutions solve real-world customer problems rather than just meeting technical requirements.
  • You will act as the owner for the India product suite, moving beyond technical delivery to partner with our GTM teams to ensure the commercial viability and market fit of our entire offering. This includes partnering with commercial leaders to understand merchant pain points holistically—from onboarding and pricing to support and retention, ensuring Adyen’s value proposition is seamless across all touchpoints.
  • Serve as the domain expert for the Indian market, identifying new acquiring capabilities and navigating complex regulatory requirements.
  • Work with engineering on resource planning and execution, balancing high-stakes performance and scalability with the rollout of new features.
  • You will build and lead a team of product managers focused on product development for Adyen India, both in your specific areas and with a strong focus on cross-team and solution synergies across Adyen globally.
  • You will work across Engineering, Data Science, Analytics, Product teams and closely collaborate with commercial teams such as Sales/AMs, and Product Marketing.
  • You combine strategic leadership with a willingness to dive into the details when needed, taking end-to-end ownership to drive clarity in scope, priorities, and requirements

Who You Are

  • 15+ years of experience in product management, with a proven track record of shipping high-quality products at scale. Experience in the Indian fintech or financial services sector is preferred.
  • You have autonomously delivered impact by leading and leveraging a portfolio of product managers across product areas.
  • You are effective in finding, growing, leading and retaining talent in product management (5+ years of management experience)
  • You possess a "founder’s mentality," and are comfortable operating at the intersection of product, sales, and operations, and you use data-driven insights to make high-stakes trade-offs that benefit the long-term health of Adyen’s merchant customers.
  • Deep knowledge of the Indian payments ecosystem, including card schemes, UPI, digital wallets, and local "money flow" regulations.
  • Proven ability to translate complex merchant needs into a comprehensive product roadmap that creates a "multiplier effect" across the business, driving both top-line growth and operational efficiency.
  • You succeed in creating a multiplier effect, in connecting with other leaders on opportunities and scaling impactful ways of working.
  • Ability to guide cross-functional teams using analytics to not only drive product decisions but also to quantify the business value and ROI of our localized offerings.
  • Action-Oriented- A relentless bias toward action and tangible outcomes in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
  • You have solid and inspiring communication skills to interact with both internal and external stakeholders as well as the teams working on and contributing to Adyen India.
  • You love to act as a mentor and help guide talent to make optimal decisions.

Our Diversity, Equity and Inclusion commitments

Our unique approach is a product of our diverse perspectives. This diversity of backgrounds and cultures is essential in helping us maintain our momentum. Our business and technical challenges are unique, and we need as many different voices as possible to join us in solving them - voices like yours. No matter who you are or where you’re from, we welcome you to be your true self at Adyen.

Studies show that women and members of underrepresented communities apply for jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. Does this sound like you? If so, Adyen encourages you to reconsider and apply. We look forward to your application!

What’s next?

Ensuring a smooth and enjoyable candidate experience is critical for us. We aim to get back to you regarding your application within 5 business days. Our interview process tends to take about 4 weeks to complete, but may fluctuate depending on the role. Learn more about our hiring process here. Don’t be afraid to let us know if you need more flexibility.

This role is based out of our Bengaluru office. We are an office-first company and value in-person collaboration; we do not offer remote-only roles.

title: Manager, Product Management
descriptionHtml:
Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.

Title And Summary

Manager, Product Management

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping

build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure,

simple, smart, and accessible. Our technology, innovation, partnerships, and networks help people, businesses, and governments realize

their greatest potential.

Title and Summary

Manager, Product Management

The Open Finance Data Access team is looking for a Manager, Data Connectivity to own connectivity performance across financial institution

(FI) integrations. This role is responsible for defining performance standards, setting metrics and targets, and driving the roadmap for

connection success rates, latency, durability, and partner experience.

The ideal candidate is passionate about open banking, highly analytical, and comfortable working across product, engineering, infrastructure, and support teams. This person will define what good looks like for FI connectivity, align stakeholders around priorities, and translate platform

needs into a clear roadmap, measurable outcomes, and better visibility through dashboards, APIs, and webhooks.

Overview

FI connectivity performance is a major driver of partner trust and end-user conversion. In this role, you will define and drive the performance

strategy for connectivity across key financial institutions and workflows, including the metrics, standards, and roadmap that shape platform

outcomes.

You will lead initiatives that strengthen production performance, reduce avoidable failures, and deliver clear health insights for internal teams

and external partners, while ensuring connectivity capabilities evolve in line with product and platform priorities.

Role

In This Role, You Will

Own FI connectivity performance, including quality, reliability, and customer experience outcomes.

Define and track key health metrics such as success rate, latency, durability, and data quality.

Define the visibility capabilities needed to measure connectivity health through dashboards, alerts, APIs, and webhooks.

Partner across product and engineering teams to prioritize platform problems, align on tradeoffs, and drive roadmap execution.

Set resilience standards and performance expectations for the connectivity platform and drive initiatives that improve durability at scale.

Drive platform initiatives such as intelligent batching and workflow optimization to improve performance and reduce redundant FI API calls.

Maintain and improve visibility into data provider integrations, including important connection attributes and dependencies.

Drive cross-functional alignment and ensure teams have clear ownership, priorities, and operating plans.

Champion a customer-first, data-driven approach to connectivity optimization.

All About You

The ideal candidate for this position should:

Be passionate about open banking and financial data connectivity.

Have strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Be able to identify patterns, diagnose issues, and turn insights into action.

Have experience owning API reliability and performance at scale across complex data connectivity platforms.

Be able to work effectively across product and engineering teams to solve platform-level problems and drive execution.

Communicate clearly and translate technical issues into business impact.

Have experience defining performance metrics, identifying bottlenecks, and driving performance optimization in large-scale distributed

systems.

Understand OAuth flows, legacy authentication methods, and common integration challenges.

Be familiar with data connectivity architectures, platform health metrics, and the tools used to assess reliability, latency, and data quality.

Be able to work through ambiguity, manage dependencies, and drive execution across teams.

Lead with empathy, clarity, and collaboration.

Corporate Security Responsibility

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks come with inherent risk to the organization. Therefore, every

person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices.

Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed.

Report any suspected information security violation or breach.

Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines

Corporate Security Responsibility

 All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

  • Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
  • Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
  • Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
  • Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Group Product Manager
descriptionHtml:
Job Description: Group Product Manager / Marketing Manager

Role Overview

We are seeking a dynamic and seasoned Group Product Manager / Marketing Manager to lead strategic brand management, product development, and market execution. This role is pivotal in driving business growth for our existing portfolio and evaluating adjacent category opportunities. The position reports directly to the Vice President.

  • Department: Marketing (pharma OTC/ Generic)
  • Vacancies: 1
  • Experience Required: 8 to 12 years (Antiseptic, OTC, or Wellness spaces)
  • Compensation Budget: ₹25 - 30 Lakhs per annum
  • Location: Mumbai (Andheri)

Educational Qualification

  • Must hold an MBA in Marketing from a reputed institution.

Key Responsibilities & Job Role

  • Strategic Business Planning: Create and establish comprehensive annual business plans for the existing brand/product portfolio.
  • Growth Support Plans: Develop targeted support plans designed to achieve overarching business and brand objectives.
  • Execution & Accountability: Take full ownership of the successful, timely execution of all agreed marketing initiatives and brand activities.
  • Performance Reporting: Maintain regular, transparent reporting of business and sales performance across the assigned portfolio.
  • Market Opportunity Assessment: Assess and evaluate emerging opportunities within the Antiseptic and adjacent wellness categories.
  • Hypothesis Testing: Formulate and validate market hypotheses on consumer relevance and developmental feasibility to unlock new segments.
  • Cross-Functional Execution: Execute finalized strategic category plans through seamless cross-functional coordination and robust external vendor management.
  • End-to-End Brand Management: Lead brand analysis, campaign planning, and creative asset execution, including promotional pipelines.
  • Competitive Intelligence: Monitor market shifts, trade challenges, competitive communications, and competitive product developments to actively share actionable insights internally.

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Core Category Experience: 8–12 years of hands-on experience managing a prominent brand in the Antiseptic, OTC, or Wellness spaces, with a strong focus on competitive strategy.
  • Proven Autonomy: Minimum of 3–5 years of experience independently managing a complex brand, category, or sub-category.
  • Sales & Distribution Grounding: At least 2–3 years of foundational experience within a standard Sales & Distribution structure is highly preferred.
  • Commercial Acumen: Strong commercial knowledge of end-to-end business operations.
  • Domain Expertise: Highly proficient in:
  • Brand Planning & Media Strategy
  • New Product Development (NPD)
  • Digital Marketing
  • Sales Mechanics & Trade Dynamics

title: Deputy Manager - Product Management
descriptionHtml:
About Business

JOB DESCRIPTION

Adani Group: Adani Group is a diversified organisation in India comprising 10 publicly traded companies. It has created a world class logistics and utility infrastructure portfolio that has a pan-India presence. Adani Group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, in the state of Gujarat, India. Over the years, Adani Group has positioned itself to be the market leader in its logistics and energy businesses focusing on large scale infrastructure development in India with O & M practices benchmarked to global standards. With four IG rated businesses, it is the only Infrastructure Investment Grade issuer in India.

Adani Solar:Adani Solar is India's 1st and largest vertically integrated solar PV manufacturer with 4 GW cells & modules and 2 GW of ingots & wafers manufacturing capacities

Job Purpose:The Lead - Product Management is responsible for overseeing the entire product lifecycle, ensuring that products meet customer needs and market demands. This role involves developing product strategies, collaborating with internal teams, and managing product performance. The Lead - Product Management is also accountable for ensuring product roadmaps are aligned with business objectives, while driving innovation and efficiency within the product development process.

Responsibilities

Product Strategy and Vision:

  • Develop and execute the product strategy, aligning with company goals. Define product vision, objectives, and KPIs to drive growth and innovation.

Market Research And Analysis

  • Conduct market research to understand customer needs, market trends, and competitive landscape. Use insights to guide product decisions and identify opportunities.

Product Development Lifecycle

  • Manage the full product lifecycle, from ideation to launch. Ensure timely product releases and collaborate with cross-functional teams for successful execution.

Product Positioning And Pricing

  • Define product positioning, messaging, and pricing strategies in collaboration with sales and marketing teams to meet customer needs and stay competitive.

Cross-functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with sales, marketing, engineering, and customer support teams to ensure alignment on product development and customer experience.

Product Lifecycle Management

  • Oversee product improvements and manage updates based on customer feedback and market trends. Decide on product enhancements or discontinuation when necessary.

Customer Feedback And Product Improvement

  • Collect and prioritize customer feedback to enhance product features. Continuously refine products to improve customer satisfaction and market fit.

Product Performance Tracking

  • Track product performance using KPIs, sales data, and feedback. Optimize product performance to increase market share and customer satisfaction.

Team Leadership And Development

  • Lead and mentor the product management team, fostering collaboration, innovation, and accountability. Support team growth to achieve organizational and personal goals.

Product Marketing Collaboration

  • Collaborate with marketing teams on product launch strategies, promotional campaigns, and customer education to drive adoption and market penetration.

Key Stakeholders - Internal

  • Head - Product Management
  • Sales Team
  • Marketing Team
  • Supply Chain/Logistics Team
  • R&D/Innovation Team

Key Stakeholders - External

  • Vendors/Suppliers
  • Customers (for product feedback)
  • External Consultants/Industry Experts
  • Regulatory Bodies

Qualifications

Educational Qualification:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field. MBA or equivalent product management certification is a plus.

Customer Feedback And Product Improvement

Product Performance Tracking



- Track product performance using KPIs, sales data, and feedback. Optimize product performance to increase market share and customer satisfaction.

Team Leadership And Development



- Lead and mentor the product management team, fostering collaboration, innovation, and accountability. Support team growth to achieve organizational and personal goals.

title: Product Owner
descriptionHtml:
Product Owner - IT - Digital Products & CX.

Work Location: Dubai

As an Product Owner, you will help manage and improve a real estate mobile app from end to end. Working closely with the Product Manager, your role is to turn business needs and user requirements into practical product features that deliver a smooth and engaging experience.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Product Execution:
  • Break down business requirements into user stories, manage the backlog, and ensure features are delivered correctly and meet expectations.
  • Team Collaboration:
  • Work daily with developers, designers, and stakeholders in an Agile setup—participating in sprints, clarifying requirements, and keeping everyone aligned.
  • UX & Quality Focus:
  • Review app designs and live features to ensure they are user-friendly, consistent, and meet high usability standards.
  • Content Management:
  • Oversee all in-app content (like property details, banners, messaging) to ensure it is accurate, well-structured, and aligned with branding.
  • Analytics & Improvement:
  • Track user behavior and app performance (engagement, conversions, drop-offs) and use insights to suggest improvements and optimizations.
  • Domain Understanding:
  • Build knowledge of real estate workflows (buyers, renters, agents) and help enhance features like search, listings, and lead management.

What We’re Looking For

  • Strong experience in product ownership / business analysis (5–7+ years)
  • Hands-on with Agile/Scrum methodologies
  • Skilled in user story writing and requirement definition
  • Good understanding of UX principles and customer-first thinking
  • Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills
  • Experience with mobile apps and analytics tools is a plus

title: Product Owner (Client Experience)
descriptionHtml:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Product Owner (Client Experience) based in India.

This role focuses on shaping and improving the post-payment experience for a global digital product used by millions of customers worldwide. You will be responsible for ensuring that paying users quickly reach meaningful value by successfully connecting and engaging with relevant matches. The position sits at the intersection of product strategy, user behavior, and data-driven optimization, with a strong emphasis on activation and customer success. You will work in a fast-paced, international environment alongside cross-functional teams including analytics, design, and engineering. The goal is to reduce friction in discovery and matching flows while increasing user satisfaction and engagement. This is a high-impact role where your decisions directly influence user retention and perceived product value across multiple global markets.

Accountabilities

  • Own and continuously improve the post-payment customer journey across core product experiences, ensuring users reach meaningful engagement quickly and consistently.
  • Increase user activation by helping paying customers find high-quality matches and sustain early communication within the first week of use.
  • Identify friction points in discovery, recommendation, and matching flows, and design solutions to improve relevance and user satisfaction.
  • Optimize the quality and personalization of offers, invites, and recommendations based on user behavior and preferences.
  • Define and refine customer segmentation strategies to tailor experiences to different user needs and expectations.
  • Collaborate closely with analytics, engineering, and design teams to test hypotheses, measure impact, and iterate on solutions.
  • Develop engagement and reactivation mechanics, including personalization, gamification, and communication tools to improve retention and value realization.

Requirements

  • Strong experience in B2C product management, ideally in platforms with complex discovery, matching, or recommendation systems.
  • Proven track record of improving user activation, onboarding, or time-to-value in consumer-facing digital products.
  • Solid understanding of customer journey design, particularly in post-payment or subscription-based environments.
  • Experience working with data-driven product development, including experimentation, A/B testing, and behavioral analysis.
  • Ability to design and improve segmentation, personalization, and recommendation logic.
  • Strong analytical mindset with the ability to identify core user problems beyond surface-level feature requests.
  • Experience working with high-choice environments where users navigate multiple offers, options, or pathways.
  • Fluent Russian is required.

Benefits

  • Fully remote work opportunity.
  • 28 calendar days of annual vacation.
  • 7 wellness days per year for rest and personal needs without using sick leave.
  • Annual training and development support (50% coverage) for courses, conferences, and professional events.
  • English language learning discounts for employees.
  • Health support allowance of up to $1,000 gross per year for medical insurance or healthcare expenses for employees and close family members.
  • Workplace support budget of up to $1,000 gross every 3 years for home office setup or co-working space expenses.
  • Internal gamified recognition system with rewards redeemable for merchandise, experiences, and team activities.
  • Referral bonuses of up to $5,000 for successful candidate recommendations.

How Jobgether Works

We use an AI-powered matching process to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.

We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!

Why Apply Through Jobgether?

Data Privacy Notice: By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Jobgether will process your personal data to evaluate your candidacy and share relevant information with the hiring employer. This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). You may exercise your rights (access, rectification, erasure, objection) at any time.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Product Strategist / Product Owner / Business Analyst IRC292695
descriptionHtml:
Description

Experience Range: 9-12 Years

About the Role: We are looking for an experienced Product Owner to lead the continuous development of the platform. In this role, you will help build a solution that provides drug manufacturers with an efficient, single point of access to distribute limited distribution drugs (LDDs) through the most clinically expert channels. Our platform aggregates real-world data, supports advanced therapy management programs, and integrates deeply with health system EMR infrastructure to deliver superior patient outcomes and reduce the total cost of care. Furthermore, you will be instrumental in identifying and integrating AI enhancement capabilities wherever needed to optimize operational processes and elevate patient care outcomes.

Requirements

What You Will Own (Key Platform Capabilities):

As the Product Owner, you will drive the roadmap, backlog, and feature execution for critical platform functionalities, including:


  • AI & Process Optimization: Leveraging AI enhancement capabilities across the platform wherever needed to streamline operational workflows, automate complex processes, and drive better patient care outcomes.
  • Data & Analytics: Centralized data aggregation and reporting across a national network of health system specialty pharmacies, alongside real-world drug usage analytics and insights for manufacturer partners.
  • EMR Integration: EMR-integrated therapy management and adherence programs delivered right at the point of care.
  • Compliance & Safety: Comprehensive adverse event (AE) capture and reporting to support post-market pharmacovigilance, as well as REMS (Risk Evaluation and Mitigation Strategy) implementation and management for complex drugs.
  • Patient & Payer Services: Features enabling prior authorization coordination, patient financial advocacy services, and consultative payer relationship management for better reimbursement outcomes.


Job responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

Product Strategy & Roadmap


  • Define and own the product roadmap for the specialty pharmacy network platform, aligning with organizational strategy and manufacturer, payer, and health system needs
  • Translate complex healthcare workflows — including LDD distribution, REMS management, and therapy management — into clear product requirements and user stories.
  • Stay ahead of industry trends in specialty pharmacy, value-based care, and ACO models to inform product direction.
  • Champion a patient-centered product philosophy, ensuring every feature decision prioritizes care continuity and clinical outcomes.


Stakeholder Collaboration


  • Act as primary product liaison between clinical teams, engineering, drug manufacturer partners, payer contacts, and health system network members.
  • Facilitate requirements-gathering sessions with specialists, pharmacy coordinators, Patient Financial Advocates (PFAs), and therapy management nurses
  • Manage competing priorities across a diverse stakeholder ecosystem including manufacturers, IDNs, payers, and internal operations
  • Build strong relationships with manufacturer partners and health system members to identify product improvement opportunities


Backlog Management & Execution


  • Own and maintain a prioritized product backlog; write detailed, actionable user stories with acceptance criteria
  • Partner with engineering and UX teams through agile sprint cycles to deliver high-quality product increments
  • Define, measure, and report on key product KPIs including therapy initiation rates, adherence outcomes, AE reporting completeness, and data accuracy
  • Ensure data aggregation pipelines and manufacturer-facing analytics meet contractual and quality standards


Compliance & Quality


  • Ensure product solutions support full compliance with REMS documentation requirements, specialty pharmacy accreditation standards (URAC), and applicable regulations.
  • Collaborate with compliance and clinical teams to embed adverse event reporting and safety monitoring into product workflows
  • Support audit readiness for LDD contract requirements and manufacturer program specifications.


Data & Analytics


  • Drive development of real-world data products that provide manufacturers with actionable insights on drug utilization, adherence, and clinical outcomes
  • Define data quality standards across the network and ensure consistent operating procedures are reflected in system design
  • Partner with data engineering teams to build aggregated, de-identified data feeds that meet manufacturer and payer reporting needs


What we offer

Exciting Projects: We focus on industries like High-Tech, communication, media, healthcare, retail and telecom. Our customer list is full of fantastic global brands and leaders who love what we build for them.

Collaborative Environment: You Can expand your skills by collaborating with a diverse team of highly talented people in an open, laidback environment — or even abroad in one of our global centers or client facilities!

Work-Life Balance: GlobalLogic prioritizes work-life balance, which is why we offer flexible work schedules, opportunities to work from home, and paid time off and holidays.

Professional Development: Our dedicated Learning & Development team regularly organizes Communication skills training(GL Vantage, Toast Master),Stress Management program, professional certifications, and technical and soft skill trainings.

Excellent Benefits: We provide our employees with competitive salaries, family medical insurance, Group Term Life Insurance, Group Personal Accident Insurance , NPS(National Pension Scheme ), Periodic health awareness program, extended maternity leave, annual performance bonuses, and referral bonuses.

Fun Perks: We want you to love where you work, which is why we host sports events, cultural activities, offer food on subsidies rates, Corporate parties. Our vibrant offices also include dedicated GL Zones, rooftop decks and GL Club where you can drink coffee or tea with your colleagues over a game of table and offer discounts for popular stores and restaurants!

About GlobalLogic

GlobalLogic, a Hitachi Group Company, is a trusted digital engineering partner to the world’s largest and most forward-thinking companies. Since 2000, we’ve been at the forefront of the digital revolution – helping create some of the most innovative and widely used digital products and experiences. Today we continue to collaborate with clients in transforming businesses and redefining industries through intelligent products, platforms, and services.

In this role, you will help build a solution that provides drug manufacturers with an efficient, single point of access to distribute limited distribution drugs (LDDs) through the most clinically expert channels. Our platform aggregates real-world data, supports advanced therapy management programs, and integrates deeply with health system EMR infrastructure to deliver superior patient outcomes and reduce the total cost of care. Furthermore, you will be instrumental in identifying and integrating AI enhancement capabilities wherever needed to optimize operational processes and elevate patient care outcomes.

Requirements

What You Will Own (Key Platform Capabilities):

As the Product Owner, you will drive the roadmap, backlog, and feature execution for critical platform functionalities, including:




- AI & Process Optimization: Leveraging AI enhancement capabilities across the platform wherever needed to streamline operational workflows, automate complex processes, and drive better patient care outcomes.
- Data & Analytics: Centralized data aggregation and reporting across a national network of health system specialty pharmacies, alongside real-world drug usage analytics and insights for manufacturer partners.
- EMR Integration: EMR-integrated therapy management and adherence programs delivered right at the point of care.
- Compliance & Safety: Comprehensive adverse event (AE) capture and reporting to support post-market pharmacovigilance, as well as REMS (Risk Evaluation and Mitigation Strategy) implementation and management for complex drugs.
- Patient & Payer Services: Features enabling prior authorization coordination, patient financial advocacy services, and consultative payer relationship management for better reimbursement outcomes.


Job responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

Product Strategy & Roadmap




-  Define and own the product roadmap for the specialty pharmacy network platform, aligning with organizational strategy and manufacturer, payer, and health system needs
-  Translate complex healthcare workflows — including LDD distribution, REMS management, and therapy management — into clear product requirements and user stories.
-  Stay ahead of industry trends in specialty pharmacy, value-based care, and ACO models to inform product direction.
-  Champion a patient-centered product philosophy, ensuring every feature decision prioritizes care continuity and clinical outcomes.


Stakeholder Collaboration




-  Act as primary product liaison between clinical teams, engineering, drug manufacturer partners, payer contacts, and health system network members.
-  Facilitate requirements-gathering sessions with specialists, pharmacy coordinators, Patient Financial Advocates (PFAs), and therapy management nurses
-  Manage competing priorities across a diverse stakeholder ecosystem including manufacturers, IDNs, payers, and internal operations
-  Build strong relationships with manufacturer partners and health system members to identify product improvement opportunities


Backlog Management & Execution




-  Own and maintain a prioritized product backlog; write detailed, actionable user stories with acceptance criteria
-  Partner with engineering and UX teams through agile sprint cycles to deliver high-quality product increments
-  Define, measure, and report on key product KPIs including therapy initiation rates, adherence outcomes, AE reporting completeness, and data accuracy
-  Ensure data aggregation pipelines and manufacturer-facing analytics meet contractual and quality standards


Compliance & Quality




-  Ensure product solutions support full compliance with REMS documentation requirements, specialty pharmacy accreditation standards (URAC), and applicable regulations.
-  Collaborate with compliance and clinical teams to embed adverse event reporting and safety monitoring into product workflows
-  Support audit readiness for LDD contract requirements and manufacturer program specifications.


Data & Analytics




-  Drive development of real-world data products that provide manufacturers with actionable insights on drug utilization, adherence, and clinical outcomes
-  Define data quality standards across the network and ensure consistent operating procedures are reflected in system design
-  Partner with data engineering teams to build aggregated, de-identified data feeds that meet manufacturer and payer reporting needs


What we offer

Exciting Projects: We focus on industries like High-Tech, communication, media, healthcare, retail and telecom. Our customer list is full of fantastic global brands and leaders who love what we build for them.

Collaborative Environment: You Can expand your skills by collaborating with a diverse team of highly talented people in an open, laidback environment — or even abroad in one of our global centers or client facilities!

Work-Life Balance: GlobalLogic prioritizes work-life balance, which is why we offer flexible work schedules, opportunities to work from home, and paid time off and holidays.

Professional Development: Our dedicated Learning & Development team regularly organizes Communication skills training(GL Vantage, Toast Master),Stress Management program, professional certifications, and technical and soft skill trainings.

Excellent Benefits: We provide our employees with competitive salaries, family medical insurance, Group Term Life Insurance, Group Personal Accident Insurance , NPS(National Pension Scheme ), Periodic health awareness program, extended maternity leave, annual performance bonuses, and referral bonuses.

Fun Perks: We want you to love where you work, which is why we host sports events, cultural activities, offer food on subsidies rates, Corporate parties. Our vibrant offices also include dedicated GL Zones, rooftop decks and GL Club where you can drink coffee or tea with your colleagues over a game of table and offer discounts for popular stores and restaurants!

About GlobalLogic

GlobalLogic, a Hitachi Group Company, is a trusted digital engineering partner to the world’s largest and most forward-thinking companies. Since 2000, we’ve been at the forefront of the digital revolution – helping create some of the most innovative and widely used digital products and experiences. Today we continue to collaborate with clients in transforming businesses and redefining industries through intelligent products, platforms, and services.

title: Product Manager – Investigation management - data42
descriptionHtml:
Summary

The vision of data42 is to inspire collaborative, groundbreaking data and AI initiatives to reimagine drug discovery at Novartis and accelerate time to market, ultimately transforming healthcare and improving lives.

As the Product Manager for Investigation Management in data42, you will drive the end-to-end product that enables teams to design, execute, and learn from investigations across R&D—bringing together scientific questions, compliant data access, and guided workflows. You will ensure investigators can seamlessly browse relevant datasets, compose investigation scopes, complete forms, and derive transparent, reproducible findings—accelerating evidence generation and portfolio decisions. Join our team at data42!

About The Role

Major accountabilities:

  • Define and communicate the Investigation Management product vision and roadmap, balancing automation with user functionality, and release management (e.g., Investigation request form, UX improvements, LLM-assisted suggestions).
  • Engage end users (researchers, GPHs, data scientists, data engineers, data explorers) to gather requirements, validate personas, and prioritize features via the product council based on scientific impact and operational feasibility.
  • Lead cross-functional delivery across engineering and UX to:
    • Implement LLM-enabled capabilities for form completion, analogy-based scope suggestions, and similar-investigation recommendations.
    • Improve transparency and usability (opt-out for findings/conclusions, clearer data promises during form filling).
    • Assess and evolve application components based on end-user-derived requirements.
  • Own the product lifecycle from ideation to launch and continuous improvement:
    • Scope Investigation Management release thoroughly; implement non-disruptive near-term changes where no fundamental technical issues exist.
    • Evaluate data source alternatives and risks; ensure data inventory and subset per release.
  • Establish and track product metrics:
    • Adoption of investigation cycle-time, data readiness coverage, user satisfaction, and quality/traceability of findings.
    • Measure contribution of LLM features to efficiency and accuracy within compliance constraints.
  • Translate scientific workflows and trial risk management needs into intuitive, governed experiences:
    • From scientific question to scoped investigation, to anonymized data browsing, to reproducible findings.
    • Support co-discovery by surfacing similar scopes and guiding users through transparent, documented decisions.
  • Ensure governed, compliant access to data:
    • Align with privacy, security, and governance standards for anonymization and RWE integration.
  • Consolidate and improve documentation hygiene (creating a single source of truth from fragmented Confluence content) to reduce ambiguity for end users.
Minimum Requirements

We are looking for a strategic and hands-on Product Manager who thrives at the intersection of science, data, and technology, and is passionate about operationalizing investigation workflows at scale. You should excel at translating scientific questions and risk management needs into intuitive, governed digital experiences that balance automation with expert user control.

  • Product Management Expertise:
    • Proven ability to define product vision, strategy, and roadmap for workflow-heavy products.
    • Experience coordinating delivery of modular, integrated releases and managing product councils (or equivalent governance).
  • Data and Technical Acumen:
    • Experience/Familiarity in working with data platforms, data pools, anonymization, RWD integration, and multi-layer architectures.
    • Extensive working knowledge with GenAI/LLM-assisted features (form completion, scope suggestions, similarity search) and their constraints in regulated settings.
    • Understanding of data models, metadata standards and alignment, and trade-offs in switching or harmonizing sources.
  • Leadership and Collaboration:
    • Skilled in influencing diverse stakeholders (GPHs, data scientists, data engineers, “data explorers”) and aligning on requirements from end-user interviews.
    • Ability to manage feedback fatigue and drive clarity on personas and value propositions.
  • Scientific and Data Literacy:
    • Understanding of R&D investigation workflows, trial risk management needs, and multi-modal data readiness.
    • Ability to translate scientific questions into data requirements and governed access patterns.
Work Experience

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Life Sciences, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
  • 5+ years of product management experience in data-driven or workflow-centric products; exposure to pharma R&D or scientific data platforms preferred.
  • Track record delivering complex, cross-functional products with strong execution and change management.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills focused on data readiness, usability, and compliance.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement abilities; experience consolidating fragmented documentation.
  • Familiarity with agile methodologies and modern product management tools.

Languages

  • English.

Why Novartis: Helping people with disease and their families takes more than innovative science. It takes a community of smart, passionate people like you. Collaborating, supporting and inspiring each other. Combining to achieve breakthroughs that change patients’ lives. Ready to create a brighter future together? https://www.novartis.com/about/strategy/people-and-culture

Benefits and Rewards: Learn about all the ways we’ll help you thrive personally and professionally.

Read our handbook (PDF 30 MB)

Job Description

The Lead Business Systems Analyst functionally leads a team of Business Systems Analysts who develop business and functional work products to support new projects and existing applications for the organization. He/She plans Business Systems Analysis (BSA) teamwork, allocates resources to projects, and reviews work products to ensure quality and adherence to organizational standards. This position guides project teams to achieve quality deliverables. He/She mediates conflicts to ensure successful team dynamics and to mitigate risks (e.g., project’s progress, successful completion, etc.). This position provides leadership in the development of BSA work products, standards, process improvements, and defect resolution. He/She leads Information Services (I.S.) projects to ensure the completion of deliverables for small projects or components of larger projects. The Lead Business Systems Analyst determines the impact and integration of solutions to business processes and systems. He/She serves as a liaison between the business community and I.S. This position researches industry best practices, standards, trends, tools, methodologies, emerging technologies, and techniques. The Lead Business Systems Analyst collaborates with stakeholders and senior management to establish and implement processes that enhance efficiency and improve work products for the enterprise. This position assists junior team members with project related activities and tasks.

Employee Type

Permanent

UPS is committed to providing a workplace free of discrimination, harassment, and retaliation.

title: Product Owner
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Solinas, a deep-tech startup incubated at IIT Madras, is India’s pioneering asset management venture transforming the water and sanitation sector. Recognized and commended by Prime Minister Narendra Modi, Solinas is on a mission to tackle pressing challenges such as manual scavenging, water accessibility, and the prevention of floods and sewer overflows. At the core of our vision lies a commitment to developing homegrown, affordable robotics and AI solutions for pipeline inspections, manhole and septic tank cleaning, and underground asset management.


Since 2018, we have transformed operations across 30+ cities, earning accolades such as Best On-Campus Startup by the Economic Times, an appearance on Shark Tank India, and partnerships with industry leaders like Ashirvad Pipes and The/Nudge Institute. On the global stage, Solinas has been named Best Southeast Asian Startup by Imagine H2O — a testament to our innovation, impact, and purpose driven growth


About the role

As Product Owner for Swasth AI, you'll sit at the intersection of engineering, field operations, and customer impact. You'll own the product backlog, translate real-world infrastructure problems into actionable user stories, and work hand-in-hand with our engineering team to ship features that utilities and city planners actually use. This is not a coordination role. You'll be a decision-maker — setting priorities, challenging assumptions, and holding the bar for quality and user value.


What You'll Own

Product Strategy & Backlog

✓ Own and continuously refine the product backlog, ensuring every item is well-defined, prioritized, and tied to real user value

✓ Translate field visits, customer conversations, and data into crisp epics and user stories the team can act on immediately

✓ Define and track KPIs that actually measure whether the product is working — not just whether it shipped Cross-Functional Leadership

✓ Be the connective tissue between engineering, operations, sales, and the end users in the field

✓ Facilitate sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives that energize the team rather than drain it

✓ Communicate product direction clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences — including leadership Delivery & Execution

✓ Drive Agile ceremonies using SAFe or Scrum, ensuring the team moves fast without breaking trust

✓ Proactively surface risks and blockers — and come with a proposed path forward, not just a flag

✓ Travel to customer sites when needed to gather ground-truth requirements; infrastructure problems can't always be understood from a desk


What We're Looking For

Must-Have

✓ 3–5 years of experience as a Product Owner or Product Manager in a product-based company or startup ✓ Proven ability to own a backlog end-to-end in an Agile environment (SAFe, Scrum, or Kanban)

✓ Strong communication skills — you write clearly, present confidently, and listen carefully

✓ Data-driven mindset: you make decisions backed by evidence, not gut instinct alone

✓ Technical acumen sufficient to have credible conversations with engineers about architecture and trade-offs


Great to Have

✓ Experience with pipeline, utilities, water/wastewater, or smart city infrastructure

✓ Product Owner or Project Management certification (CSPO, SAFe PO/PM, PMI-ACP)

✓ Background in product marketing or go-to-market strategy ✓ Experience managing multiple products simultaneously


Why Solinas

✓ Work on technology that prevents manual scavenging and saves lives

✓ Direct access to leadership: you'll work closely with the leadership team and have real influence on product direction

✓ High-growth startup with proven traction: 30+ cities, multiple national awards, Shark Tank India alumni ✓ Competitive salary with performance-linked incentives and comprehensive healthcare

✓ A team of engineers, roboticists, and domain experts who take the mission seriously — and have fun doing it

title: Lead Product Owner
descriptionHtml:
Role Summary:-

The Lead Product Owner drives complex product initiatives, mentors Product Owners and Analysts, and establishes delivery standards across functional domains.

The role is expected to lead adoption of AI-enabled delivery operating models and drive consistency, scalability, and quality across teams.

The Lead Product Owner is a member of the Product Management team of IDIT R&D, responsible for managing a team of Product Owners. The candidate should be able to run workshops with domain managers, Product Managers, and customers to elicit requirements, present solution designs, and take requirements through to implementation.

Pre-requisites

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering (CS/IT preferred) or equivalent qualification.
  • MBA preferred.

Experience

  • 8–12 years of relevant experience.
  • Should have some technical experience before transitioning to a BA/Product role.
  • Insurance or BFSI experience is a must.
  • Prior knowledge of Core Insurance is a must.
  • Experience of having worked in at least two implementation projects.
  • Led end-to-end requirements across multiple domains and modules.

Key Responsibilities

 Functional Leadership Responsibilities

  • Drive large and complex product initiatives across insurance functions.
  • Lead solution alignment across Product, Engineering, Architecture, QA, and Delivery teams.
  • Define product execution standards and governance practices.
  • Drive backlog prioritization aligned to strategic objectives.
  • Mentor Product Owners and Analysts; conduct training sessions for team members.
  • Support customer escalations and strategic initiatives.
  • Ensure consistency across functional deliverables and delivery practices.
  • Conduct User Forums and stakeholder workshops.
  • Work as a senior representative to project teams as needed.
  • Analysis and solution design using AI-assisted tools and frameworks.

title: Senior Product Manager (content management)
descriptionHtml:
About Responsive

Responsive (formerly RFPIO) is the global leader in strategic response management software, transforming how organizations share and exchange critical information. The AI-powered Responsive Platform is purpose-built to manage responses at scale, empowering companies across the world to accelerate growth, mitigate risk and improve employee experiences. Nearly 2,000 customers have standardized on Responsive to respond to RFPs, RFIs, DDQs, ESGs, security questionnaires, ad hoc information requests and more. Learn more at responsive.io.

About The Role

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to lead product strategy and execution for Content Management - the knowledge foundation powering AI-assisted responses across the Responsive platform. Content Management is evolving from a traditional repository and governance system into an intelligent knowledge platform powered by AI. The goal is to help customers ingest, curate, improve, govern, and maintain high-quality knowledge with significantly lower manual effort.

  • Intelligent Knowledge Management - This role will focus on building intelligent content management capabilities using AI agents, automation, and workflow intelligence to continuously improve content quality, freshness, trust, and reusability across enterprise response workflows.
  • AI-powered governance and automation - Areas of focus include AI-assisted ingestion and organization, stale content detection, knowledge recommendations, trust and governance workflows, and reducing operational effort involved in content management.
  • Customer and workflow orientation - The role requires strong understanding of enterprise workflows and close engagement with customers and field teams to understand how knowledge quality impacts AI-assisted response workflows and business outcomes.
  • Systems thinking and product depth - We are looking for someone who can think deeply about content systems, knowledge workflows, metadata, trust, permissions, reuse, and AI-assisted orchestration - not just standalone features.

What You’ll Own

  • Define and evolve the roadmap for Content Management capabilities across the Responsive platform
  • Drive product direction for: AI-assisted content ingestion and organization Content quality, freshness, and lifecycle management Trusted retrieval and AI-grounded responses AI-powered governance and automation workflows
  • Improve how organizational knowledge is reused across various use cases - including responses (RFx, questionnaires), field/team queries, and trust center experiences.
  • Define, measure and improve success metrics around content quality, trust, reuse, and operational efficiency
  • Partner closely with Engineering, AI/ML teams, UX, GTM, and customer-facing teams
  • Engage with customers and field teams to understand knowledge management and governance challenges

What We’re Looking For

Required

  • 7+ years of Product Management experience in SaaS, platform, or enterprise workflow products
  • Strong systems thinking and structured problem-solving ability
  • Demonstrated ownership of outcomes, not just feature delivery
  • Experience working with Engineering and AI/ML teams on complex product or platform capabilities
  • Strong product judgment, prioritization, and communication skills
  • Demonstrated AI-first thinking and hands-on use of AI tools in day-to-day product workflows

Strong Advantages

  • Familiarity or experience with knowledge management, search/retrieval, governance, AI-assisted workflows, or content systems
  • Experience with AI-powered workflows, copilots, orchestration, or evaluation systems
  • Hands-on use of AI tools for research, prototyping, workflow design, or product development
  • Ability to prototype workflows or use AI-assisted coding tools independently
  • Technical fluency with APIs, LLMs, vector databases, or AI infrastructure concepts
  • B.Tech in Computer Science (or equivalent technical background) and MBA is a plus

title: Lead Product Owner
descriptionHtml:
Kenvue Is Currently Recruiting For a

Lead Product Owner

What We Do

At Kenvue, we realize the extraordinary power of everyday care. Built on over a century of heritage and rooted in science, we’re the house of iconic brands - including NEUTROGENA®, AVEENO®, TYLENOL®, LISTERINE®, JOHNSON’S® and BAND-AID® that you already know and love. Science is our passion; care is our talent.

Who We Are

Our global team is ~ 22,000 brilliant people with a workplace culture where every voice matters, and every contribution is appreciated. We are passionate about insights, innovation and committed to delivering the best products to our customers. With expertise and empathy, being a Kenvuer means having the power to impact millions of people every day. We put people first, care fiercely, earn trust with science and solve with courage – and have brilliant opportunities waiting for you! Join us in shaping our future–and yours. For more information, click here.

Role Reports To

Product Manager

Location:

Asia Pacific, India, Karnataka, Bangalore

Work Location:

Hybrid

What You Will Do

Kenvue is currently recruiting for:

Lead Product Owner, Data Products

This position reports into Principal Solutions Architect, Global Data Products and is based in GCC, Bengaluru.

What You Will Do

As a Lead Product Owner, you will be responsible for leading the development and deployment of data-driven products powered by digital, artificial intelligence and analytics technologies. You will work closely with cross-functional teams, including data scientists, software engineers, product managers, and business stakeholders to define product vision, strategy, and execution.

Responsibilities

  • Product Vision and Strategy: Collaborate with stakeholders to define the product vision, goals, and roadmap for Digital, Data and AI products that align with business objectives.
  • Requirements Gathering: Work closely with business units to understand their needs and translate them into clear and actionable product requirements.
  • Data Management: Oversee data collection, storage, and preprocessing to ensure data quality and availability for training and model deployment.
  • Machine Learning Models: Coordinate with data scientists and ML engineers to design, develop, and deploy machine learning models that power AI data products.
  • Product Development: Lead the end-to-end product development process, including design, development, testing, and deployment of AI data products.
  • Performance Monitoring: Establish metrics and tracking mechanisms to measure the performance and impact of AI data products.
  • Product Iteration and Improvement: Continuously iterate and improve data products based on user feedback and performance insights.
  • Market Analysis: Conduct market research and competitive analysis to identify opportunities and stay abreast of industry trends.

Required Qualifications

What We Are Looking For

  • Typically requires a minimum of 8 years of related experiences with a Bachelor's degree; or 5 years and a Master degree in Business or Information management systems (MIS); or a PhD with 5 years of experiences in the field of Technology, Computer/Software Engineering, Data Science, Applied Mathematics, Statistics etc.
  • 3+ years of experience working in CPG/Retail industry and sound knowledge in business/data domains related to Customer, Product, Consumer, Finance etc.
  • Proven experience in product management, preferably with a focus on data-driven products and AI technologies.
  • Understand business requirements and translate to Conceptual (CDM), Logical (LDM) and Physical (PDM) data model by using industry standards.
  • Familiarity with machine learning concepts, algorithms, and model deployment.
  • Strong project management skills and the ability to lead cross-functional teams.
  • Proficiency in data analysis, visualization, and data-driven decision-making and proficiency in writing SQL Queries.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills to effectively convey complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Understanding of data privacy and security considerations in AI product development.
  • Experience with Agile development methodologies is a plus.
  • Experience working in Data Governance, Metadata Management, Data Catalog and Business Glossary.

If you are an individual with a disability, please check our Disability Assistance page for information on how to request an accommodation.

title: Senior Specialist, POM Product Owner
descriptionHtml:
Job Description

Senior Specialist, POM Product Owner

We’re seeking a future team member for the role of SENIOR SPECIALIST to join our Corporate Trust – Analytics team. This role is located in Pune, MH.

In this role, you’ll make an impact in the following ways:

  • Position Summary - This position is responsible for analyzing and understanding deal requirements and then building/programming computer models to reflect those requirements.
  • The incumbent will be required to read and understand deal related legal documentation and identify the relevant details and information to enable them to create the deal model in BNY proprietary tools/Excel. In addition, the Analyst will provide support and ongoing maintenance for existing deal models using both bespoke and proprietary systems.
  • This role supports and assists the Client onshore to ensure delivery of good client service by accurate and timely completion of client requests. The quality and timeliness directly affect how the organization is perceived by our clients.

To be successful in this role, we’re seeking the following:

  • T-SQL, PL/SQL or similar database query writing experience is must.
  • 6+ Years of experience as SQL/ SSRS / Power BI developer is desired.
  • Knowledge of programming languages like VBA, Java, .Net would be a plus but not mandatory.
  • Candidate should have good Analytical and Problem-solving skills.
  • Experience in Git Lab would be a plus.
  • Understanding of structured finance product CDO (Collateralized Debt Obligation) and other financial instruments (Bonds, Loans, Swaps, etc.) would be a plus.
  • Experience in Finance domain would be a plus.

About Us

At BNY, our culture allows us to run our company better and enables employees’ growth and success. As a leading global financial services company at the heart of the global financial system, we influence nearly 20% of the world’s investible assets. Every day, our teams harness cutting-edge AI and breakthrough technologies to collaborate with clients, driving transformative solutions that redefine industries and uplift communities worldwide.

Recognized as a top destination for innovators, BNY is where bold ideas meet advanced technology and exceptional talent. Together, we power the future of finance – and this is what is all about. Join us and be part of something extraordinary.

About The Team

At BNY, our culture speaks for itself, check out the latest BNY news at: BNY Newsroom & BNY LinkedIn

Here’s a Few Of Our Recent Awards

  • America’s Most Innovative Companies, Fortune, 2025
  • World’s Most Admired Companies, Fortune 2025
  • “Most Just Companies”, Just Capital and CNBC, 2025

Our Benefits And Rewards

BNY offers highly competitive compensation, benefits, and wellbeing programs rooted in a strong culture of excellence and our pay-for-performance philosophy. We provide access to flexible global resources and tools for your life’s journey. Focus on your health, foster your personal resilience, and reach your financial goals as a valued member of our team, along with generous paid leaves, including paid volunteer time, that can support you and your family through moments that matter.

BNY is an Equal Employment Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer - Underrepresented racial and ethnic groups/Females/Individuals with Disabilities/Protected Veterans.

title: FFC Banking Book Business Product Owner- Analyst
descriptionHtml:
hackajob is collaborating with J.P. Morgan to connect them with exceptional professionals for this role.

Job Description

Join Firmwide Financial Controllers to drive strategic data and platform transformation across Finance, Credit Risk, and Treasury. You will shape the Banking Book roadmap, improve data quality, and deliver monthly releases through strong product ownership and governance. This role offers broad stakeholder exposure and the opportunity to build scalable, cloud-enabled data foundations.

As a Banking Book Product Owner Analyst within Firmwide Financial Controllers (FFC) on the Business Architecture team, you will partner with lines of business, SMEs, and technology teams to translate product and data needs into scalable Finance and Risk solutions. You will prioritize the Banking Book roadmap, manage monthly release delivery, and apply disciplined program and change governance across data acquisition, testing, and adoption. You will drive data quality, lineage, and process improvements to strengthen decision-useful reporting and operational efficiency.

Job Responsibilities

  • Prioritize Banking Book product backlog and define a roadmap aligned to Finance and Risk data acquisition objectives.
  • Write business requirements as user stories with clear acceptance criteria to enhance data, testing, reporting automation, and analytics toolsets.
  • Partner with developers to translate business needs into technical specifications and validate delivered outcomes.
  • Manage release plans covering scope, milestones, resourcing, test strategy, execution readiness, and stakeholder activities.
  • Collaborate with lines of business to understand products, data capture, and strategic sourcing into cloud-based big data architecture.
  • Drive adherence to product, SDLC, and release management standards and operating models.
  • Identify process improvement opportunities and produce supporting documentation to enhance end-user experience.
  • Coordinate with implementation leads, release managers, project managers, and data SMEs to align data/system flows with Finance and Risk applications.
  • Oversee SDLC execution from requirements through testing and deployment to ensure seamless integration and delivery.
  • Analyze datasets to identify trends and support decisions while strengthening data governance, quality, and management practices.
  • Support DQ analysis and remediation activities by tracking issues, actions, and outcomes through to closure.

Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills

  • Hold a Bachelorâs degree with 3+ years of experience in product ownership or project management focused on process re-engineering.
  • Demonstrate Product Owner experience and strong working knowledge of agile principles and delivery of complex programs.
  • Apply strong analytical and problem-solving skills to rapidly assimilate business and technical knowledge.
  • Use Jira and Microsoft Office effectively to manage workflow, documentation, and stakeholder coordination.
  • Communicate complex concepts clearly to diverse audiences through strong written and verbal communication.
  • Manage multiple workstreams concurrently with strong organization, sound judgment, and a risk mindset.
  • Operate effectively under pressure with high attention to detail and ownership of deadlines and deliverables.

Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills

  • Leverage SQL and data tooling experience, including Databricks and visualization/analytics tools (e.g., Tableau, Alteryx, Python).
  • Apply knowledge of traditional credit products (e.g., loans, deposits, cash) and/or trading products (e.g., derivatives, securities).
  • Demonstrate experience as a product lead in Finance, Risk, or Operations within financial services.
  • Apply familiarity with liquidity and credit reporting data and related sourcing/controls.
  • Demonstrate understanding of financial and regulatory reporting processes.
  • Utilize basic knowledge of cloud technologies (e.g., AWS).

title: Product Owner - Platform Production
descriptionHtml:
A Snapshot of Your Day

Join Siemens Gamesa and step into a hands-on role where you shape how SCADA hardware platforms are built, configured, and delivered at scale. You start your day partnering with engineering, production, and procurement to ensure the right hardware and software, BOMs, and variants are ready for real projects. You lead decisions that balance standardization, flexibility, cost, and compliance, keeping platforms reliable and easy to manufacture. Along the way, you stay close to business units on production processes and suppliers, turning long-term platform standards into practical, repeatable solutions that support the global energy transition.

How You’ll Make An Impact

  • Own and maintain the generic and configurable Bill of Materials (BOM) for SCADA projects across business units
  • Define and manage product variants and part numbers, ensuring accuracy, usability, and lifecycle clarity
  • Collaborate with engineering, production, and suppliers to ensure hardware platforms meet software, system, and project requirements
  • Ensure platforms are compliance-ready, including CE and UL marking, working closely with internal teams and suppliers
  • Partner with Business units, production facilities, procurement, and service teams to deliver manufacturable, scalable, and well-documented SCADA solutions


What You Bring

  • Experience as a Product Owner, Product Manager, or in a similar role within hardware, platform, or industrial systems
  • Strong understanding of BOM structures, product variants, and product lifecycle management
  • Hands-on experience working with production environments, suppliers, and procurement teams
  • Familiarity with product compliance and certification standards such as CE and UL
  • Clear, confident communication skills and the ability to collaborate across technical, operational, and commercial stakeholders


About The Team

You will join the Platform Production Team within Siemens Gamesa, focusing on SCADA hardware platforms and BOM management. The team works across engineering, production, procurement, suppliers, and delivery organizations to ensure SCADA platforms are reliable, compliant, and easy to configure. Together, the team supports the full lifecycle of SCADA panel deliveries, from design and production to installation and upgrades. Collaboration, trust, and practical problem-solving are central to how the team operates. The work directly supports multiple business units and real customer projects worldwide.

Who is Siemens Gamesa?

Siemens Gamesa is part of Siemens Energy, a global leader in energy technology with a rich legacy of innovation spanning over 150 years. Together, we are committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. As a leading player in the wind industry and manufacturer of wind turbines, we are passionate about driving the energy transition and providing innovative solutions that meet the growing energy demand of the global community. At Siemens Gamesa, we are constantly seeking individuals to join our team and support our focus on energy transformation. Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Gamesa: https://www.siemens-energy.com/global/en/home/careers/working-with-us.html

Our Commitment to Diversity

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by multiple nationalities. We celebrate character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

Rewards/Benefits

  • Opportunities to work with a global team
  • Medical benefits
  • Remote/Flexible work
  • Paid holidays and parental leave
  • Employer-funded pension
  • Subsidised lunch and more
