title: Product Owner Payables & T&E - Manager
descriptionHtml:
At PwC, our people in finance focus on providing financial advice and strategic guidance to clients, helping them optimise their financial performance and make informed business decisions. These individuals handle financial analysis, budgeting, forecasting, and risk management.

In financial operations at PwC, you will focus on managing financial processes and confirming compliance with regulations. You will handle tasks such as financial reporting, budgeting, and risk management.

The Opportunity

  • When you join PwC Acceleration Centers (ACs), you step into a pivotal role focused on actively supporting various Acceleration Center services, from Advisory to Assurance, Tax and Business Services. In our innovative hubs, you’ll engage in challenging projects and provide distinctive services to support client engagements through enhanced quality and innovation. You’ll also participate in dynamic and digitally enabled training that is designed to grow your technical and professional skills.
  • As part of the Finance Operations team you will support the development and communication of product vision and strategy for the SAP S4HANA System. As a Manager, you will serve as a liaison between business stakeholders and IT teams, facilitating alignment and timely delivery of product increments. This role presents a unique opportunity to influence financial software development and enhance operational effectiveness within the organization.

Responsibilities

  • Support the development and communication of product strategy for SAP S4HANA
  • Act as a liaison between business and IT teams to confirm alignment
  • Facilitate the timely delivery of product increments and updates
  • Influence the development of financial software to enhance effectiveness
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to gather and prioritize requirements
  • Manage project risks and issues proactively
  • Drive initiatives that improve operational processes
  • Mentor team members to build skills and capabilities

What You Must Have

  • Bachelor's Degree
  • 9 years of experience
  • Oral and written proficiency in English required

What Sets You Apart

  • 9 to 13 years of experience
  • Skilled in SAP technologies and data management
  • Excelling in translating business needs into technical requirements
  • Supporting product vision and strategy development
  • Prioritizing features based on business impact
  • Maintaining a well-defined product backlog
  • Facilitating agile ceremonies and team alignment
  • Managing delivery of product increments and user feedback
  • Promoting product management and agile methodologies

title: Associate - Specialist - Product Owner
descriptionHtml:
Specialist - Product Owner - IN

The role act as liaisons between different stakeholders, including engineering, operations, and business to execute product strategy. They maintain and manage the product backlog, or the prioritized list of requirements for future product development.

Key Responsibilities And Duties

  • Incumbents in this role may also be responsible for modernization and integration efforts.
  • Product Owners work very closely with Product Managers to create user stories.
  • They author documents relating to product life cycle including product roadmap, business requirements and functional specifications.
  • They participate in sprint planning, perform market research and competitive analysis leading to the iterative development of the product.

Educational Requirements

  • University (Degree) Preferred

Work Experience

  • 3+ Years Required; 5+ Years Preferred

Physical Requirements

  • Physical Requirements: Sedentary Work

Career Level

7IC

  • Liaising with different stake holders and business users to understand the requirement/problem areas and work with development team to resolve it.
  • Good understanding of Asset management and different asset classes in capital market.
  • Create detailed documentation and flow diagrams for the requirement and proposed solutions
  • Collecting data from various sources via different processes, understand those processes.
  • Exploring and visualizing data.
  • Should be able to write SQL queries and fetch the data and review it.
  • Clearly communicating the findings from the analysis to turn information into something actionable through reports, dashboards, and/or presentations.

Key Skills Required:

  • Analyzing and translating business needs to create and propose solutions through presentations and flow diagram
  • Experience with data integration from multiple sources
  • Experience with End of day and Start of day activities on Accounting book of records
  • Must have Proficiency in at least one query language, especially SQL. (Python Preferred)
  • Must have experience in Asset management domain.
  • Understanding of Performance calculation & Analytics domain
  • Must have experience in different asset classes and their performance, attribution.
  • Experience with PostgreSQL DB is good to have.
  • Good communication skills.

Required Experience- 5-10 Years

Education- Engineering/ Masters (Finance)/CIPM/CFA/FRM or equivalent certification

Related Skills

Continuous Integration and Deployment, Debugging, DevOps, Enterprise Application Integration, Problem Solving, Programming, Software Development, Software Development Life Cycle, Software Testing, Systems Design/Analysis, Systems Development Life Cycle

Company Overview

TIAA Global Capabilities was established in 2016 with a mission to tap into a vast pool of talent, reduce risk by insourcing key platforms and processes, as well as contribute to innovation with a focus on enhancing our technology stack. TIAA Global Capabilities is focused on building a scalable and sustainable organization , with a focus on technology , operations and expanding into the shared services business space.

Working closely with our U.S. colleagues and other partners, our goal is to reduce risk, improve the efficiency of our technology and processes and develop innovative ideas to increase throughput and productivity.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. TIAA does not discriminate against any candidate or employee on the basis of age, race, color, national origin, sex, religion, veteran status, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other legally protected status.

Our Culture of Impact

At TIAA, we're on a mission to build on our 100+ year legacy of delivering for our clients while evolving to meet tomorrow's challenges. We equip our associates with future-focused skills and AI tools that enable us to advance our mission. Together, we are fighting to ensure a more secure financial future for all and for generations to come. We are guided by our values: Champion Our People, Be Client Obsessed, Lead with Integrity, Own It, and Win As One. They influence every decision we make and how we work together to serve our clients every day. We thrive in a collaborative in-office environment where teams work across organizational boundaries with shared purpose, accelerating innovation and delivering meaningful results. Our workplace brings together TIAA and Nuveen's entrepreneurial spirit, where we work hard and work together to create lasting impact. Here, every associate can grow through meaningful learning experiences and development pathways—because when our people succeed, our impact on clients' lives grows stronger.

- Collaborate with lines of business to understand products, data capture, and strategic sourcing into cloud-based big data architecture.
- Drive adherence to product, SDLC, and release management standards and operating models.
- Identify process improvement opportunities and produce supporting documentation to enhance end-user experience.
- Coordinate with implementation leads, release managers, project managers, and data SMEs to align data/system flows with Finance and Risk applications.
- Oversee SDLC execution from requirements through testing and deployment to ensure seamless integration and delivery.
- Analyze datasets to identify trends and support decisions while strengthening data governance, quality, and management practices.
- Support DQ analysis and remediation activities by tracking issues, actions, and outcomes through to closure.

Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills



- Hold a Bachelor's degree with 3+ years of experience in product ownership or project management focused on process re-engineering.
- Demonstrate Product Owner experience and strong working knowledge of agile principles and delivery of complex programs.
- Apply strong analytical and problem-solving skills to rapidly assimilate business and technical knowledge.
- Use Jira and Microsoft Office effectively to manage workflow, documentation, and stakeholder coordination.
- Communicate complex concepts clearly to diverse audiences through strong written and verbal communication.
- Manage multiple workstreams concurrently with strong organization, sound judgment, and a risk mindset.
- Operate effectively under pressure with high attention to detail and ownership of deadlines and deliverables.

Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills



- Leverage SQL and data tooling experience, including Databricks and visualization/analytics tools (e.g., Tableau, Alteryx, Python).
- Apply knowledge of traditional credit products (e.g., loans, deposits, cash) and/or trading products (e.g., derivatives, securities).
- Demonstrate experience as a product lead in Finance, Risk, or Operations within financial services.
- Apply familiarity with liquidity and credit reporting data and related sourcing/controls.
- Demonstrate understanding of financial and regulatory reporting processes.
- Utilize basic knowledge of cloud technologies (e.g., AWS).
- Promote strong data governance and lineage practices to support auditability and sustainable controls.

About Us

JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.

We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

Our professionals in our Corporate Functions cover a diverse range of areas from finance and risk to human resources and marketing. Our corporate teams are an essential part of our company, ensuring that we're setting our businesses, clients, customers and employees up for success.

Global Finance & Business Management works to strategically manage capital, drive growth and efficiencies, maintain financial reporting and proactively manage risk. By providing information, analysis and recommendations to improve results and drive decisions, teams ensure the company can navigate all types of market conditions while protecting our fortress balance sheet.

Flexera saves customers billions of dollars in wasted technology spend. A pioneer in Hybrid ITAM and FinOps, Flexera provides award-winning, data-oriented SaaS solutions for technology value optimization (TVO), enabling IT, finance, procurement and cloud teams to gain deep insights into cost optimization, compliance and risks for each business service. Flexera One solutions are built on a set of definitive customer, supplier and industry data, powered by our Technology Intelligence Platform, that enables organizations to visualize their Enterprise Technology Blueprint™ in hybrid environments—from on-premises to SaaS to containers to cloud.

We’re transforming the software industry.  We’re Flexera.  With more than 50,000 customers across the world, we’re achieving that goal. But we know we can’t do any of that without our team. Ready to help us re-imagine the industry during a time of substantial growth and ambitious plans?  Come and see why we’re consistently recognized by Gartner, Forrester and IDC as a category leader in the marketplace. Learn more at flexera.com

We are hiring a Product Owner to drive the TI Platform execution work, with a focus on data and third-party integration to enhance overall platform capabilities. Reporting to the Director of Product Management, you will manage the product backlog, prioritize features, and collaborate with engineering, and stakeholders to deliver seamless integrations that support Flexera’s strategic goals.

Key Responsibilities

  • TI Platform Data Model and Key Service Development:
  • Define and prioritize the product backlog for TI Platform, focusing on data and third-party integration to streamline our overall roadmap.
  • Collaborate with engineering to design and implement API and AI-first solutions, ensuring compatibility with Flexera One.
  • Drive integration with internal products (e.g., IT Visibility dashboards, CCO, ITAM, etc systems) to enhance data flows and analytics.
  • Stakeholder Collaboration:
  • Act as the primary liaison between Product Management, engineering, and internal teams, ensuring alignment on priorities and deliverables.
  • Facilitate Agile ceremonies (e.g., sprint planning, retrospectives) to maintain momentum post our recent Itasca workshop.
  • Translate business needs into technical requirements, creating user stories and acceptance criteria.
  • Adoption and Continuous Improvement:
  • Drive adoption of platform services across internal teams, targeting 90% adoption within six months.
  • Gather feedback from stakeholders to iterate on connector features, ensuring they deliver measurable value (e.g., improved cost tracking).

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of product management experience, with 3+ years as a Product Owner in a technical integration role.
  • Proven expertise in API and AI-first integrations
  • Experience with Agile/Scrum methodologies, managing backlogs, and working with cross-functional teams.
  • Familiarity with Data Model, Lakehouse, and Data product knowledge
  • Strong communication skills to bridge technical and business stakeholders.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Business, or related field;

Why Join Flexera?

  • Shape the future of IT management by driving impactful integrations for TI Platform.
  • Enjoy competitive salary, benefits, and flexible work options.

Flexera is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  Qualified applicants will be considered for open roles regardless of age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by local/national laws, policies and/or regulations.

Our DEI (Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion) council is the driving force behind our commitment to championing policies and practices that foster a welcoming environment for all.

title: Associate Product Owner
descriptionHtml:
Summary

Description Summary of This Role

Leads the planning and rollout of assigned products through ownership of product concepts, roadmaps, and prioritization with delivery teams. Navigates a dynamic and distributed stakeholder and development environment to build and maintain a prioritized roadmap. Owns product backlog and release plan. Champions and supports the product development team by reducing churn and waste, removing blockers, escalating issues and offering ideas, solutions, and technical product guidance.

What Part Will You Play?

  • For moderately complex product offerings, leverages expertise in financial services markets and/or Agile software product development to drive product innovation, roadmap priorities, and requirements for the assigned product offering that serves to further distinguish our capabilities from the competition and to deepen engagement for our clients’ customers. Close collaboration with product development team is key to success.
  • Works closely with our leadership, sales, and client teams to pinpoint opportunities for our strategic focus, and ensures the release themes and plans align to deliver the capabilities to enable winning in the marketplace. Determines methods and procedures for alignment to product strategy.
  • Facilitates product innovation and roadmap planning sessions. Actively offers ideas, solutions, and technical product guidance on solution feasibility, approach, and high level scope.
  • Participates in release and sprint planning sessions to select appropriate priorities from the product backlog for inclusion in the release priorities. Able to discern appropriate priorities from the backlog based on a variety of factors, including input from multiple teams (Market Strategy, Portfolio Management, and Client Implementations, among others), scope/sizing considerations, functional synergies, etc.
  • Adopts the structured approach to facilitate product scenario, epic, and solution requirements sessions for product enhancements. Actively participates in design review and product demo sessions, offering critical and insightful feedback.
  • Drives effective release priority communications plan to ensure that all appropriate internal teams have visibility to the contents of critical commitments in the releases, as well as visibility into overall product readiness. This includes ensuring that key product decisions made within the delivery cycle are communicated and understood so that product readiness and intent are achieved. May include driving and coordinating many aspects of go-to-market planning and execution (e.g. pricing, contracts, value proposition and messaging, etc.).
  • Works with technical writing team members to deliver product documentation to ensure effective internal and external communications of each release. This includes user guides, implementation guides, release notes, and various internal release communication sessions.
  • Collaborates within and outside of the product management team to ensure product relevance and prioritization across segment offerings.
  • Not an exhaustive list; other duties as assigned.

What Are We Looking For in This Role?

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree
  • Relevant Experience or Degree in: Computer Science or equivalent field from an accredited university is required; however, relevant experience in lieu of a degree may be considered.
  • Typically a minimum of 6 years
  • Demonstrated track record in product development/management, preferably cloud based SaaS products in a client-facing environment. Strong technical aptitude. Experience with Agile delivery methodology preferred.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master's Degree
  • Computer Science or equivalent field from an accredited university.

What Are Our Desired Skills and Capabilities?

  • Skills / Knowledge - Having wide-ranging experience, uses professional concepts and company objectives to resolve moderately complex issues in creative and effective ways. Having ownership of a sub-function, account or matrix management responsibilities, applies knowledge to meet goals, maintain relationships, propose opportunities to expand the business, and lead matrix teams. Some barriers to entry exist at this level (e.g., dept./peer review).
  • Job Complexity - Works on complex issues where analysis of situations or data requires an in-depth evaluation of variable factors. Exercises judgment in selecting methods, techniques and evaluation criteria for obtaining results. Networks with key contacts outside own area of expertise. Builds on/Maintains external relationships of assigned accounts.
  • Supervision - Determines methods and procedures on new assignments and may coordinate activities of other personnel (Team Lead).

title: Senior Manager Product Marketing
descriptionHtml:
Working as a Global Senior Product Marketing Manager, you will own the roadmap of certain discrete security ICs including OPTIGA™ TPM. You will be responsible for identifying new security use-cases and building products from an idea to successful launch. You are excellent at storytelling, strategic in customer needs and market fit, and have a strong technical aptitude and business acumen. You thrive in a fast-paced work environment, drive clarity in ambiguity, excel in prioritization and make hard trade-offs.

In your new role you will:

  • Own certain security related products from an idea to a successful launch, with a competitive value proposition and in close cooperation with system architecture team and R&D.
  • Be fully vested in the whole product creation cycle from product idea, through specification definition, business case preparation, tracking of project activities and generation of launch plans.
  • Develop a successful product roadmap & strategy for certain sub-verticals of the ‘Embedded Security’ category.
  • Initiate innovative ideas or projects to drive segment strategy and lead the project execution to achieve tangible result
  • Conduct effective and comprehensive customer research to understand market size and opportunity, needs and wants, and the competitive landscape. Deliver those data-driven insights as inputs into the product roadmap.
  • Develop Ecosystem partners, both internally and externally.
  • Align with Application Marketing & Product Management and contribute to the G2M strategy.
  • Act as Marketing / business development interface when required and consult with our customers in the selection of products, related development tools and Software by deploying technical marketing and application engineering resources as required.
  • Run regular updates with all stakeholders for alignment and launch orchestration.

You are best equipped if you have:

  • 10+ years of related experience and at least a Bachelor's degree in Electronics Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science or related field. MBA is a plus.
  • Must have 3+ years of Semiconductor Product Marketing or Management experience.
  • 4+ years in product definition and follow-through to launch.
  • 2+ years working in a large matrixed organization.
  • Relevant experience in a marketing role in EDA or Semiconductor industries.
  • Strong technical aptitude as well as business acumen. Skilled at dealing with ambiguity in early product lifecycle.
  • A passion towards the product; be an avid advocate for the product.
  • Ability to make hard trade-offs. Comfortable at risk-taking.
  • Problem-solving skills to dissect & work through challenges. Have strategic thinking yet is detail oriented.
  • Ability to change the thinking of, or gain acceptance from, others in sensitive situations, without damage to the relationship.
  • Can work in collaborative team across geographies and functions that values diverse perspectives, inclusion, and continuous learning.
  • Can prioritize outcomes, quality, and teamwork.
  • Professional proficiency in English (C1 or equivalent).

Jyoti.Vimal@infineon.com

title: Product Owner – AGENTIC AI, Global Delivery Simplification
descriptionHtml:
Role Overview

We are hiring a Product Owner to support the design, delivery, and scale‑out of agent‑based automation across core financial services operations. This role sits within the Global Delivery Simplification organization and contributes to reimagining how complex operational processes are executed using agentic AI in a regulated, control‑intensive environment.

The Product Owner will support ownership of the roadmap and value realization for agent‑driven solutions across Fund Accounting, Middle Office, Transfer Agency, and Custody, contributing to measurable improvements in efficiency, quality, and control while adhering to regulatory, audit, and data governance expectations.

This is a hands‑on product role requiring strong execution discipline, close partnership with senior Product Owners, business, and technology teams, and accountability for defined outcomes within an agreed scope..

ROLE PURPOSE

The Product Owner is part of a cross‑functional POD responsible for conceiving, delivering, and scaling agentic AI solutions across core business services including Fund Accounting, Middle Office, Transfer Agency, and Custody.

The role contributes to product strategy, roadmap execution, prioritization, and value delivery of agent‑based automation, ensuring solutions deliver operational impact while complying with enterprise risk, compliance, and governance standards.

Success in this role requires the ability to balance automation ambition with operational risk, and to design solutions where controls, auditability, and explainability are embedded from the outset.

Key Responsibilities

  • Contribute to business outcomes for agent‑based solutions, including efficiency gains, capacity release, quality improvement, and risk reduction.
  • Support definition and articulation of product vision for agentic AI use cases across assigned operational domains.
  • Develop working knowledge of end‑to‑end operational processes across Fund Accounting, Middle Office, Transfer Agency, or Custody.
  • Identify and assess opportunities where agent‑based automation can improve accuracy, cycle time, and control effectiveness.
  • Execute product roadmaps aligned to business priorities, regulatory expectations, and enterprise AI risk frameworks.
  • Translate simplification goals into user stories, acceptance criteria, and measurable success indicators.
  • Act as a proxy for the business in agile delivery, maintaining a prioritized backlog of product increments.
  • Participate in agile execution with a focus on incremental delivery, learning, and operational readiness.
  • Support the lifecycle of agentic AI solutions including problem definition, data grounding, workflow integration, approval design, and rollout.
  • Ensure controls, auditability, and evidence capture are incorporated into solution design.
  • Apply guidance on materiality thresholds, escalation paths, and failure handling for semi‑autonomous execution.
  • Monitor agent performance post‑deployment, escalating issues related to accuracy, drift, or control breaches.
  • Partner with operations SMEs, risk, data, and engineering teams to validate acceptance criteria and readiness.
  • Track KPIs tied to efficiency, quality, and cycle time; support value reporting.
  • Communicate delivery progress, risks, and dependencies to senior Product Owners and stakeholders.


Skills And Capabilities

  • Solid product management fundamentals including backlog management, prioritization, and stakeholder engagement.
  • Sound judgment with awareness of automation risk, regulatory expectations, and user trust considerations.
  • Experience working within cross‑functional agile PODs.
  • Clear communication skills with the ability to work with both technical and non‑technical partners.
  • Domain knowledge in one operational area (Fund Accounting, Middle Office, Transfer Agency, or Custody) or strong learning agility.
  • Working knowledge of prompt engineering concepts and AI risk considerations.
  • Ability to interpret basic agent performance signals and operational metrics.
  • Awareness of AI monitoring, escalation, and human‑in‑the‑loop patterns.
  • Understanding of data governance fundamentals including data quality and stewardship.


Experience Requirements

  • 4–6 years of experience in product, change, or automation roles within regulated operational environments.
  • Experience in financial services operations preferred.
  • Exposure to automation, AI, or digital transformation initiatives.
  • Experience working with technology, data, and risk partners.
  • Participation in delivering solutions into live operations.
  • Experience working in agile or product‑centric delivery models.


Minimum Salary

zł282,000 Annual

The minimum salary quoted above applies to the role in the primary location specified. If the candidate ultimately works outside of this primary location, the applicable minimum salary may differ.

Salary will be determined based on factors such as the position, type of work performed, individual skills, job description, working hours, diligence, initiative, self-management, length of employment, availability, and the quantity and quality of work delivered, as well as other objective and non-discriminatory criteria relevant to State Street employees.

In addition to salary, employees are eligible to be considered for discretionary annual performance-based awards.

We Offer

  • Permanent contract from day one
  • Additional holidays (Birthday Day Off, 3rd and 5th year anniversary Day Off)
  • Gold Medical Package for employees and their families (partner and children)
  • Premium life insurance package and private pension plan
  • Wide range of soft skills training, technical workshops, language classes and development programs
  • Opportunities to volunteer your time to company-driven initiatives, employee networks or organizations of your choice
  • Variety of well-being programs
  • Additional benefits available depending on the seniority of the role


About State Street

Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.

We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. As an essential partner in our shared success, you’ll benefit from inclusive development opportunities, flexible work-life support, paid volunteer days, and vibrant employee networks that keep you connected to what matters most. Join us in shaping the future.

As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we consider all qualified applicants for all positions without regard to race, creed, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, ethnicity, age, disability, genetic information, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, citizenship, marital status, domestic partnership or civil union status, familial status, military and veteran status, and other characteristics protected by applicable law.

This is a hands‑on product role requiring strong execution discipline, close partnership with senior Product Owners, business, and technology teams, and accountability for defined outcomes within an agreed scope..

ROLE PURPOSE

The Product Owner is part of a cross‑functional POD responsible for conceiving, delivering, and scaling agentic AI solutions across core business services including Fund Accounting, Middle Office, Transfer Agency, and Custody.

The role contributes to product strategy, roadmap execution, prioritization, and value delivery of agent‑based automation, ensuring solutions deliver operational impact while complying with enterprise risk, compliance, and governance standards.

Success in this role requires the ability to balance automation ambition with operational risk, and to design solutions where controls, auditability, and explainability are embedded from the outset.

Key Responsibilities



-  Contribute to business outcomes for agent‑based solutions, including efficiency gains, capacity release, quality improvement, and risk reduction.
-  Support definition and articulation of product vision for agentic AI use cases across assigned operational domains.
-  Develop working knowledge of end‑to‑end operational processes across Fund Accounting, Middle Office, Transfer Agency, or Custody.
-  Identify and assess opportunities where agent‑based automation can improve accuracy, cycle time, and control effectiveness.
-  Execute product roadmaps aligned to business priorities, regulatory expectations, and enterprise AI risk frameworks.
-  Translate simplification goals into user stories, acceptance criteria, and measurable success indicators.
-  Act as a proxy for the business in agile delivery, maintaining a prioritized backlog of product increments.
-  Participate in agile execution with a focus on incremental delivery, learning, and operational readiness.
-  Support the lifecycle of agentic AI solutions including problem definition, data grounding, workflow integration, approval design, and rollout.
-  Ensure controls, auditability, and evidence capture are incorporated into solution design.
-  Apply guidance on materiality thresholds, escalation paths, and failure handling for semi‑autonomous execution.
-  Monitor agent performance post‑deployment, escalating issues related to accuracy, drift, or control breaches.
-  Partner with operations SMEs, risk, data, and engineering teams to validate acceptance criteria and readiness.
-  Track KPIs tied to efficiency, quality, and cycle time; support value reporting.
-  Communicate delivery progress, risks, and dependencies to senior Product Owners and stakeholders.


Skills And Capabilities



-  Solid product management fundamentals including backlog management, prioritization, and stakeholder engagement.
-  Sound judgment with awareness of automation risk, regulatory expectations, and user trust considerations.
-  Experience working within cross‑functional agile PODs.
-  Clear communication skills with the ability to work with both technical and non‑technical partners.
-  Domain knowledge in one operational area (Fund Accounting, Middle Office, Transfer Agency, or Custody) or strong learning agility.
-  Working knowledge of prompt engineering concepts and AI risk considerations.
-  Ability to interpret basic agent performance signals and operational metrics.
-  Awareness of AI monitoring, escalation, and human‑in‑the‑loop patterns.
-  Understanding of data governance fundamentals including data quality and stewardship.


Experience Requirements



-  4–6 years of experience in product, change, or automation roles within regulated operational environments.
-  Experience in financial services operations preferred.
-  Exposure to automation, AI, or digital transformation initiatives.
-  Experience working with technology, data, and risk partners.
-  Participation in delivering solutions into live operations.
-  Experience working in agile or product‑centric delivery models.


Minimum Salary

zł282,000 Annual

The minimum salary quoted above applies to the role in the primary location specified. If the candidate ultimately works outside of this primary location, the applicable minimum salary may differ.

Salary will be determined based on factors such as the position, type of work performed, individual skills, job description, working hours, diligence, initiative, self-management, length of employment, availability, and the quantity and quality of work delivered, as well as other objective and non-discriminatory criteria relevant to State Street employees.

In addition to salary, employees are eligible to be considered for discretionary annual performance-based awards.

We Offer



- Permanent contract from day one 
- Additional holidays (Birthday Day Off, 3rd and 5th year anniversary Day Off) 
- Gold Medical Package for employees and their families (partner and children) 
- Premium life insurance package and private pension plan 
- Wide range of soft skills training, technical workshops, language classes and development programs 
- Opportunities to volunteer your time to company-driven initiatives, employee networks or organizations of your choice 
- Variety of well-being programs 
- Additional benefits available depending on the seniority of the role

Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.

We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. As an essential partner in our shared success, you’ll benefit from inclusive development opportunities, flexible work-life support, paid volunteer days, and vibrant employee networks that keep you connected to what matters most. Join us in shaping the future.

title: Senior Product Marketing Manager
descriptionHtml:
About Bureau


Every day, billions of people interact, shop, and transact online - but behind the convenience lies a growing problem: digital fraud and mistrust. Global losses now exceed US$486B annually, and the questions businesses face are simple yet critical: “Who are you?” and “Can I trust you?” Bureau answers those questions.


Bureau is an all-in-one platform for identity decisioning, fraud prevention and compliance requirements. Trusted for enhancing security and compliance, Bureau simplifies identity management for businesses. This is a place where we celebrate homegrown leaders and have an open-door policy where your voice matters, your ideas flourish, and your potential knows no bounds. We are driven to put our best foot forward every day with confidence, growth, customer obsession and speed as our core values here at Bureau. Think of us as a launching pad for your growth.


In just a few years, our knowledge graph has grown to 1 billion+ verified identities globally. Backed by Sorenson Capital and PayPal Ventures, Bureau is not just scaling fast; we’re shaping the future of digital trust.


About the Role - Senior Product Marketing Manager


Bureau is looking for a Senior Product Marketer who can independently translate our market insight and thought leadership into compelling, tangible go-to-market assets.


You’ll work directly with Sales, Product, and Leadership to define how Bureau tells its story across the Identity, Fraud, and Financial Services ecosystem.


This is a hands-on role that blends strategic clarity with strong execution - ideal for someone who enjoys owning outcomes end-to-end without needing constant direction.


What you’ll be doing


Go-to-Market & Messaging


  • Develop and maintain crisp, differentiated messaging and positioning for Bureau’s solutions across verticals and geographies (India, SEA, MEA).
  • Translate complex product capabilities in identity, fraud, and risk intelligence into simple, customer-focused narratives.
  • Support new product and feature launches with GTM collateral, internal enablement, and post-launch analysis.


Sales & Leadership Enablement


  • Work with the Sales and Leadership teams to convert Bureau’s GTM and thought leadership into decks, case studies, one-pagers, and videos that advance conversations and shorten deal cycles.
  • Build and maintain an asset library aligned to buyer stages and use cases.
  • Partner with Sales to ensure consistent messaging and positioning in every external touchpoint.


Market Intelligence & Insights

  • Research and monitor market trends, competitors, and regulatory developments in financial services, fraud prevention, and digital identity.
  • Feed actionable insights back into Product and GTM strategy to influence roadmap and positioning decisions.


Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with Product, Growth, and SDR teams to ensure alignment between market needs and product narratives.
  • Own reporting and metrics on marketing asset usage, win-rates, and adoption by sales teams.


What You’ll Bring


To shine here, you should have:


  • 6 to 10 years of experience in Product Marketing or GTM for Enterprise SaaS, preferably in Identity, Fraud, or BFSI.
  • Proven ability to work independently with Sales and Leadership to conceptualize and produce GTM deliverables without daily supervision.
  • Demonstrated experience in messaging, enablement, and launch execution for B2B tech products.
  • Strong communication and storytelling skills with an analytical mindset.
  • Comfortable working in a high-velocity, entrepreneurial environment with tight cross-functional collaboration.
  • Familiarity with CRM and automation tools such as HubSpot, Salesforce, or equivalent.


Nice to Have


  • Exposure to SEA or Middle East fintech markets.
  • Experience supporting enterprise sales teams with GTM collateral and competitive insights.
  • Previous background in enterprise sales or consulting before moving into marketing.


What Working at Bureau Looks Like


At Bureau, work is about building something meaningful, together. Some days it’s brainstorming around a whiteboard, other times it’s an idea sparked over chai or in a hallway chat. We move fast, give ownership to those closest to the problem, and turn ideas into action quickly.

Our values shape how we work and win together. We believe in Teamwork and Respect that build strong collaborations, Urgency that keeps us close to customer needs, and a Solution Mindset that drives innovation. With Transparency at the core, we strive for Excellence in everything we do and bring relentless Drive to achieve impactful outcomes. This is what working at Bureau looks like - fast, focused, and built on trust.

Flexibility is built into how we work, helping you balance deep focus with collaboration. Learning never stops: through books, courses, and knowledge-sharing. And well-being matters too, with healthcare for you and your family.


Here, you don’t just build products that protect millions - you build trust, grow your skills, and work with people who’ve got your back.


Why Join Bureau?


At Bureau, you’ll be part of a mission with real global impact: creating digital trust that allows businesses and people to transact safely, fairly, and confidently.


  • Work with purpose: Build tools that reduce fraud, expand access to credit, and protect people from digital harm.
  • Cutting-edge tech: Solve problems using AI, risk intelligence, and graph-based systems at global scale.
  • Massive scale, real-world impact: Your work will directly contribute to protecting millions of people and businesses worldwide.
  • Room to grow: Join a company scaling 4x YoY, where ownership and bold ideas are rewarded.
  • Culture that empowers: Flexible work hours, fast-paced environment, and a team that values speed and innovation.
  • Life at Bureau: From offsites and team outings to Friday snacks and friendly table tennis rivalries, we make sure there’s energy, fun, and connection beyond work.

descriptionHtml:
About Us


Exotel is one of Asia's largest customer communication platforms. We are on a mission to move enterprise customer communication to the cloud. In 2020, we powered over 4 billion calls and connected over 320 million people. We work with some of the most innovative companies such as Ola, Swiggy, Zerodha, Whitehat Jr, Practo, Flipkart, GoJek, etc. We also power customer communication for some of the top banks in the country. Join us on this journey to improve how companies look at customer communication. Read our growth story here.


About the Role


At Exotel, we help leading banks and insurers transform customer conversations at scale. As an Principal Sales Manager – Banking & Insurance, you will own large, complex enterprise deals, selling AI-powered Voice Bots, Conversational AI, CCaaS, and CPaaS solutions.


This is the senior most quota-carrying, individual contributor role with full ownership of the enterprise sales cycle.



What You’ll Do


  • Own end-to-end enterprise sales cycles across Banking & Insurance accounts
  • Drive new logo acquisition and strategic account expansion
  • Position AI & Voice Bots as levers for CX improvement, cost optimisation, and compliance
  • Engage CXOs, Digital, CX, IT, and Operations leaders
  • Lead discovery, solutioning, pricing, and contract negotiations
  • Partner with Product, Pre-sales, and CX teams to close complex deals
  • Maintain strong pipeline hygiene and forecast accuracy


Success Metrics


  • Enterprise revenue and pipeline targets
  • AI & Voice Bot deal contribution
  • Deal size, win rates, and forecast accuracy


What We’re Looking For


  • 10–18 years of enterprise B2B sales experience (SaaS, platforms, or managed services)
  • Proven experience selling to Banking & Insurance customers
  • Exposure to AI, Voice Bots, Conversational AI, CCaaS, or CPaaS solutions
  • Strong solution-selling, commercial, and executive communication skills


Who Will Succeed


  • Enterprise sellers who thrive in long, complex sales cycles
  • Professionals are comfortable selling AI with clear business outcomes
  • Self-driven, outcome-oriented, and consultative in approach

descriptionHtml:
Job Description

About this role:

Wells Fargo is seeking a Senior Lead Digital Product Manager, Solutions UI L2 product area within Workplace Services and Automation to lead end-to-product strategy, delivery, and lifecycle management of critical digital platforms used by employees across the enterprise, with direct accountability for guiding senior software development teams delivering these products.

In This Role, You Will

  • Act as an advisor to senior leadership to develop or influence digital products, initiatives, plans, specifications, resources, and long-term goals for highly complex business and technical needs across a functional area within the Digital environment
  • Lead the strategy and resolution of highly complex and unique challenges requiring in-depth evaluation across multiple areas or the enterprise
  • Deliver solutions that are long-term, large-scale and require vision, creativity, innovation, advanced analytical and inductive thinking
  • Coordinate highly complex activities and guidance to others
  • Provide vision, direction and expertise to senior leadership on implementing innovative and significant digital business plans, programs and initiatives which have significant impact
  • Strategically engage with all levels of professionals and managers across the enterprise
  • Serve as an expert advisor to leadership

Required Qualifications:

  • 7+ years of digital product management experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education

Desired Qualifications:

  • 7+ years of experience in digital product management or closely related roles
  • Proven experience owning and scaling enterprise-grade digital platforms or employee-facing technology digital products, platforms or software products
  • Strong experience working with senior software engineers and development teams in building complex, distributed systems
  • Solid understanding of:
    • Modern software architecture (cloud-native, APIs, integrations, automation)
    • SDLC, CI/CD, quality engineering, and reliability practices
  • Ability to engage deeply in technical discussions and make informed trade-off decisions (without being a hands-on coder)
  • Demonstrated leadership in large, complex digital transformation programs
  • Strong leadership experience in large, complex digital transformation initiatives
  • Deep understanding of Agile and product operating models, including backlog management and delivery at scale
  • Experience working closely with engineering teams on software platforms, integrations, APIs, and automation
  • Strong data-driven decision-making skills, including use of metrics, analytics, and ROI to prioritize work
  • Excellent communication and executive-level storytelling skills
  • Ability to operate effectively across business, technology, design, and risk functions
  • Experience in Workplace Technology, End-User Computing, Productivity Platforms, or Enterprise Automation
  • Expertise in Scaled Agile frameworks (e.g., SAFe, Nexus) and agile portfolio management
  • Strong understanding of API-led architectures, platform strategy, and automation
  • Experience operating in large, regulated environments with strong risk and compliance expectations
  • Familiarity with data analytics and visualization tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau)
  • Exposure to Design Thinking, Lean UX, and customer experience practices
  • Advanced certifications:
    • SAFe certifications
    • Product Management or Digital Transformation certifications
  • Executive education in product strategy or digital leadership
  • Bachelor's degree in technology, Engineering, Computer Science, or related field, or equivalent experience.
Job Expectations:

  • Act as a senior advisor to executive leadership, shaping long-term digital product strategy, backlog, roadmaps, and investment priorities
  • Own enterprise-scale digital products end-to-end, including vision, strategy, roadmap, backlog, delivery, and outcomes
  • Serve as Product Owner for assigned Level-2 enterprise products
  • Define product success metrics, outcomes, and value realization aligned to business strategy
  • Lead and influence senior and lead software development teams responsible for designing, building, and scaling digital products
  • Partner closely with Engineering Managers, Architects, and Lead Engineers to ensure:
    • Sound technical design and architecture
    • Scalable, secure, and resilient solutions
    • Alignment to enterprise engineering standards and patterns
  • Translate complex business problems into clear technical and functional requirements
  • Provide product and technical clarity to teams operating in agile delivery models
  • Lead resolution of highly complex, ambiguous business and technology challenges spanning multiple domains
  • Drive large-scale digital transformation initiatives, including automation and platform modernization
  • Translate business needs into clear product requirements, success metrics, and prioritized backlogs
  • Partner with Technology, XD, Automation, and Architecture teams to deliver secure, scalable, and compliant solutions
  • Influence across lines of business and senior stakeholders without formal authority
  • Balance value, risk, compliance, and technical feasibility in product decisions and ensure alignment with risk, compliance, and regulatory expectations
  • Provide thought leadership and direction on enterprise product management practices, agile ways of working, and portfolio management
  • Drive execution using Agile and scaled Agile frameworks, ensuring predictable delivery and quality outcomes
  • Balance features, technical debt, platform modernization, security, and compliance in prioritization decisions
  • Lead resolution of highly complex, ambiguous challenges spanning business and technology domains
Posting End Date:

16 Jun 2026

  • Job posting may come down early due to volume of applicants.

We Value Equal Opportunity

Wells Fargo is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other legally protected characteristic.

Employees support our focus on building strong customer relationships balanced with a strong risk mitigating and compliance-driven culture which firmly establishes those disciplines as critical to the success of our customers and company. They are accountable for execution of all applicable risk programs (Credit, Market, Financial Crimes, Operational, Regulatory Compliance), which includes effectively following and adhering to applicable Wells Fargo policies and procedures, appropriately fulfilling risk and compliance obligations, timely and effective escalation and remediation of issues, and making sound risk decisions. There is emphasis on proactive monitoring, governance, risk identification and escalation, as well as making sound risk decisions commensurate with the business unit's risk appetite and all risk and compliance program requirements.

Candidates applying to job openings posted in Canada: Applications for employment are encouraged from all qualified candidates, including women, persons with disabilities, aboriginal peoples and visible minorities. Accommodation for applicants with disabilities is available upon request in connection with the recruitment process.

Applicants With Disabilities

To request a medical accommodation during the application or interview process, visit Disability Inclusion at Wells Fargo .

Drug and Alcohol Policy

Wells Fargo maintains a drug free workplace. Please see our Drug and Alcohol Policy to learn more.

Wells Fargo Recruitment And Hiring Requirements

  • Third-Party recordings are prohibited unless authorized by Wells Fargo.
  • Wells Fargo requires you to directly represent your own experiences during the recruiting and hiring process.

descriptionHtml:
About ACA:

ACA Group is the leading governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) advisor in financial services. We empower our clients to reimagine GRC and protect and grow their business. Our innovative approach integrates consulting, managed services, and our ComplianceAlpha® technology platform with the specialized expertise of former regulators and practitioners and our deep understanding of the global regulatory landscape.

Position Summary:

The Senior Product Owner will lead the strategy and execution of the quote-to-cash product ecosystem, bridging back-office financial operations with modern business agility. This role owns platforms including Salesforce.com, Workday, and Certinia and is responsible for defining and delivering an integrated product vision across these systems.

The Senior Product Owner operates with a high degree of autonomy and accountability, driving roadmap development, aligning cross-functional stakeholders, and ensuring delivery of scalable, high-impact solutions. This role partners closely with Finance, Operations, and Technology leaders to translate business priorities into a strategic product roadmap and measurable outcomes. The role is also responsible for identifying opportunities to leverage AI, automation, data, and emerging technologies to improve operational efficiency, scalability, and business outcomes across the quote-to-cash ecosystem.

Job Duties:


  • Own and drive the end-to-end product strategy, roadmap, and backlog across the quote-to-cash ecosystem
  • Lead prioritization decisions balancing business value, risk, and operational efficiency
  • Partner with senior leaders across Finance, Technology, and Operations to define product direction and investment priorities
  • Translate complex business, customer, and technical requirements into scalable product solutions
  • Lead backlog refinement and sprint planning; facilitate cross-functional alignment at both working and leadership levels
  • Influence and negotiate vendor roadmaps to align third-party capabilities with ACA’s needs
  • Act as the primary decision-maker for product tradeoffs, ensuring alignment between short-term delivery and long-term strategy
  • Represent the voice of the business and end user within agile teams and provide clarity on priorities and acceptance criteria
  • Drive process improvement and change management across financial and sales operations
  • Develop mockups, prototypes, and business cases to support strategic decisions
  • Define and track KPIs and business outcome metrics to measure success and inform roadmap decisions
  • Provide mentorship and guidance to less experienced product owners or analysts and help elevate product practices across the organization
  • Partner with business and technology leaders to identify, prioritize, and deliver AI, automation, and digital transformation initiatives that improve operational effectiveness and user experience.
  • Collaborate with Enterprise Architecture, Engineering, and Data teams to define integration, reporting, and data governance strategies across Salesforce, Workday, Certinia, and related enterprise platforms.

Required Education and Experience:


  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field
  • 7–10+ years of progressively responsible experience in product ownership, business analysis, or related roles (updated from 5+)
  • Demonstrated experience leading complex, cross-functional product initiatives
  • Strong domain expertise in financial systems and sales/back-office operations
  • Experience working with enterprise platforms such as Salesforce, Workday, Certinia, or similar

Skills & Attributes:


  • Strategic thinking and ability to translate business objectives into product roadmaps
  • Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders and drive alignment across competing priorities
  • Strong facilitation skills, including leading cross-functional and leadership-level discussions
  • Ability to balance long-term platform strategy with near-term delivery needs
  • Advanced analytical and problem-solving capabilities
  • Demonstrated success delivering measurable business outcomes using technology
  • Strong communication skills across both business and technical audiences
  • High level of ownership, initiative, and accountability

What working at ACA offers:

We offer a competitive compensation package where you’ll be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to our business. Our Total Rewards package includes medical coverage fully funded by ACA for employees and their family as well as access to Maternity & Fertility and Wellness programs. ACA also provides Personal Accident Insurance, Group Term Life Insurance, Employee Discount programs and Employee Resource Groups. You’ll be granted time off for designated ACA Paid Holidays, Privilege Leave, Casual/Sick Leave, and other leaves of absence to support your physical, financial, and emotional well-being.

What we commit to:

ACA is firmly committed to a policy of nondiscrimination, which applies to recruiting, hiring, placement, promotions, training, discipline, terminations, layoffs, transfers, leaves of absence, compensation and all other terms and conditions of employment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability or protected veteran status, or any other legally protected status.

descriptionHtml:
The Product Developer is a seasoned professional role. Applies in-depth disciplinary knowledge, contributing to the development of new techniques and the improvement of processes and work-flow for the area or function. Integrates subject matter and industry expertise within a defined area. Requires in-depth understanding of how areas collectively integrate within the sub-function as well as coordinate and contribute to the objectives of the function and overall business. Evaluates moderately complex and variable issues with substantial potential impact, where development of an approach/taking of an action involves weighing various alternatives and balancing potentially conflicting situations using multiple sources of information. Requires good analytical skills in order to filter, prioritize and validate potentially complex and dynamic material from multiple sources. Strong communication and diplomacy skills are required. Regularly assumes informal/formal leadership role within teams. Involved in coaching and training of new recruits. Significant impact in terms of project size, geography, etc. by influencing decisions through advice, counsel and/or facilitating services to others in area of specialization. Work and performance of all teams in the area are directly affected by the performance of the individual.

Responsibilities:

  • The Product Developer is responsible for activities related to the development or new products and/or features and functionality of products including developing business cases, requirements definition (BRDs), product enhancements innovation, feature and functionality definition based on market and industry research and trends and client needs
  • This role manages the end-to-end product development lifecycle and internal applications and will also scope product releases, agreeing to and tracking business priorities, incorporating regulatory and compliance requirements and investment tracking
  • Creates a product vision aligned to business priorities and corresponding road-map to delivery
  • Follows market, industry and client trends to own field and adapts them for application Citi’s products and solutions platforms
  • Develops plans, prioritizes, coordinates design and delivery of products or features to product release, and serves as product champion within user community
  • Works in close co-ordination with Sales, Technology, Business Managers and senior stakeholders to fulfill the delivery objectives
  • Manages and implements a wide variety of products and solutions
  • Identifies solutions ranging across data analytics, reporting, CRM, Trade Workflows and trade processing
  • Has responsibility to deliver direct business results and advice regarding product development that necessitates a degree of responsibility over technical strategy
  • Partners with senior team members and leaders and a widely distributed global user community to define and implement solutions
  • Creates clear and specific project plans, business and technical requirements documents for product execution
  • Has direct interaction with business managers, technology, and sales to understand their long term vision, discuss industry trends, and incorporate them into the product & solutions strategy
  • Focuses on controls and governance, including performing Need-to-Know based security and access reviews, Access Approvals, controls testing and documentation
  • Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency.

Recommended Qualifications:

  • 5-8 years of experience
  • Intellectual curiosity, analytical and conceptual thinker
  • Proactively seeks and develops new opportunities
  • Attention to detail and process/analytic mindset
  • Ability to build networks and relationships internally and externally
  • Familiarity with product development methodologies
  • Direct experience in end-to-end project delivery, preferably in product development, and knowledge of various analytical tools including Qlikview, Tableau, Access
  • Comfortable with performing data investigations that require a high degree of accuracy with tight timescales
  • Ability to create business analysis, troubleshoot data quality issues, and conduct exploratory and descriptive analysis of business datasets
  • Ability to structure and break down problems, develop solutions, and to drive to results
  • Process Management knowledge with a propensity for detail and comprehensiveness of content
  • Ability to collaborate and clearly communicate with team members of an organization
  • Project Management skills with experience leading large cross functional initiatives
  • Generation of reports and presentations for management

Education:

  • Bachelor’s/University degree or equivalent experience

This job description provides a high-level review of the types of work performed. Other job-related duties may be assigned as required.

title: Product Owner
descriptionHtml:
Who We Are

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

The Role

Responsibilities:

  • Develop and maintain the product roadmap, ensuring alignment with citizen service delivery and departmental workflows.
  • Translate functional requirements into actionable features and user stories.
  • Engage with end-users and stakeholders to gather feedback and refine product features.
  • Lead cross-functional teams to ensure iterative and Agile development processes.
  • Define and communicate the product vision, goals, and success metrics.
  • Manage and prioritize the product backlog, ensuring alignment with business and technical objectives.
  • Collaborate with business and technical teams to ensure requirements are clearly understood and implemented.
  • Ensure compliance with government IT standards and Agile best practices.

Your Future at Kyndryl

Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career. We have opportunities that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.

Who You Are

Who You Are

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

Required Technical Skills

  • 14+ years of total experience, including 5+ years as Product Owner
  • B.Tech/BE in CS/IT + MBA (any domain) or M.Tech/M.Sc in CS/IT
  • CSPO / PMP Certified
  • Experience in Agile and Scrum, including handling sprints, burndown charts, and user stories
  • Experience in Government IT projects for 5+ years - Handled products with a budget of Rs 10 Cr+
  • Strong stakeholder management, requirements gathering, and sprint planning skills

Preferred Technical Skill

  • Kannada reading/writing/speaking
  • Familiarity with government / public sector registration workflows and citizen service delivery models
  • Agile, Scrum,CSPO / PMP Certified

Being You

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

What You Can Expect

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.

From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.

We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.

We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

Get Referred!

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

title: Product Owner – Global Fraud Solutions (India)
descriptionHtml:
TransUnion's Job Applicant Privacy Notice

What We'll Bring

We are seeking a Product Owner to join TransUnion’s Global Fraud Solutions team and play a hands-on role in delivering high-quality, customer-focused capabilities across our Core Fraud Solutions.

As a Product Owner, your primary focus will be translating product and business needs into well-defined user stories, supporting development teams through execution, and ensuring delivered functionality meets business expectations. You’ll work closely with Product Managers, Engineering, QA, and business stakeholders, owning day-to-day backlog execution and UAT readiness rather than high-level feature or epic ownership.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys working close to delivery, thrives in Agile environments, and takes pride in the quality and completeness of what gets released.

This position is based in India, with limited travel.

What You'll Bring

What You’ll Do

  • Work closely with Product Managers to understand product vision and roadmap, and translate them into clear, actionable user stories for development teams.
  • Own the day-to-day product backlog execution, including writing user stories, defining acceptance criteria, refining requirements, and supporting backlog grooming sessions.
  • Break down requirements into executable stories that can be delivered within a sprint, ensuring clarity for engineering and QA teams.
  • Create lightweight wireframes, user flows, or mockups to clearly communicate user experience and functional expectations.
  • Actively support Agile scrum teams by answering questions, clarifying requirements, and making quick trade-off decisions during development.
  • Plan, coordinate, and participate in User Acceptance Testing (UAT) by defining test scenarios, validating solutions, and ensuring readiness for release.
  • Partner with QA, Engineering, and stakeholders to ensure defects, enhancements, and refinements are properly understood and prioritized.
  • Work effectively in a matrixed, global environment with multiple development teams and stakeholders.
  • Use modern tools, including AI-enabled tools, to improve productivity in story writing, analysis, documentation, testing support, and overall delivery efficiency.

Impact You'll Make

What You Bring

  • 5+ years of experience as a Product Owner, Business Analyst, or in a similar delivery-focused product role within B2B software or services.
  • Strong hands-on experience writing user stories, defining acceptance criteria, and supporting sprint execution.
  • Proven experience working in Agile/Scrum teams and supporting multiple sprint teams simultaneously.
  • Solid experience with UAT execution, including test planning, validation, and stakeholder sign-off.
  • Ability to create wireframes, mockups, or user flows to support requirement clarity and user experience discussions.
  • Familiarity with identity fraud, risk management, authentication, or financial services platforms is highly desirable.
  • Good understanding of application architecture, APIs, databases, and system integrations, enabling effective collaboration with engineering teams.
  • Comfort using AI-powered tools to enhance analysis, documentation, testing workflows, or delivery outcomes (hands-on experience is a plus; curiosity and openness are essential).
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across diverse teams.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Technology, Engineering, or a related field. MBA preferred

This is a hybrid position and involves regular performance of job responsibilities virtually as well as in-person at an assigned TU office location for a minimum of two days a week.

descriptionText:
TransUnion's Job Applicant Privacy Notice

What We'll Bring

We are seeking a Product Owner to join TransUnion’s Global Fraud Solutions team and play a hands-on role in delivering high-quality, customer-focused capabilities across our Core Fraud Solutions.

As a Product Owner, your primary focus will be translating product and business needs into well-defined user stories, supporting development teams through execution, and ensuring delivered functionality meets business expectations. You’ll work closely with Product Managers, Engineering, QA, and business stakeholders, owning day-to-day backlog execution and UAT readiness rather than high-level feature or epic ownership.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys working close to delivery, thrives in Agile environments, and takes pride in the quality and completeness of what gets released.

This position is based in India, with limited travel.

What You'll Bring

What You’ll Do



- Work closely with Product Managers to understand product vision and roadmap, and translate them into clear, actionable user stories for development teams.
- Own the day-to-day product backlog execution, including writing user stories, defining acceptance criteria, refining requirements, and supporting backlog grooming sessions.
- Break down requirements into executable stories that can be delivered within a sprint, ensuring clarity for engineering and QA teams.
- Create lightweight wireframes, user flows, or mockups to clearly communicate user experience and functional expectations.
- Actively support Agile scrum teams by answering questions, clarifying requirements, and making quick trade-off decisions during development.
- Plan, coordinate, and participate in User Acceptance Testing (UAT) by defining test scenarios, validating solutions, and ensuring readiness for release.
- Partner with QA, Engineering, and stakeholders to ensure defects, enhancements, and refinements are properly understood and prioritized.
- Work effectively in a matrixed, global environment with multiple development teams and stakeholders.
- Use modern tools, including AI-enabled tools, to improve productivity in story writing, analysis, documentation, testing support, and overall delivery efficiency.

Impact You'll Make

What You Bring



- 5+ years of experience as a Product Owner, Business Analyst, or in a similar delivery-focused product role within B2B software or services.
- Strong hands-on experience writing user stories, defining acceptance criteria, and supporting sprint execution.
- Proven experience working in Agile/Scrum teams and supporting multiple sprint teams simultaneously.
- Solid experience with UAT execution, including test planning, validation, and stakeholder sign-off.
- Ability to create wireframes, mockups, or user flows to support requirement clarity and user experience discussions.
- Familiarity with identity fraud, risk management, authentication, or financial services platforms is highly desirable.
- Good understanding of application architecture, APIs, databases, and system integrations, enabling effective collaboration with engineering teams.
- Comfort using AI-powered tools to enhance analysis, documentation, testing workflows, or delivery outcomes (hands-on experience is a plus; curiosity and openness are essential).
- Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across diverse teams.
- Bachelor’s degree in Business, Technology, Engineering, or a related field. MBA preferred

This is a hybrid position and involves regular performance of job responsibilities virtually as well as in-person at an assigned TU office location for a minimum of two days a week.

TransUnion Job Title

Consultant, Product Management

title: Data Product Owner
descriptionHtml:
What You’ll Do

  • Oversee the full lifecycle of data assets, from ingestion and maintenance to accessibility and optimization.
  • Define and understand customer needs related to D&A assets, ensuring that our products deliver value and meet market demands.
  • Develop and execute a strategic vision for Decision Intelligence’s D&A assets, contributing to the overall success of the business.
  • Act as a Technical Product Manager, driving product development and ensuring alignment with business objectives.
  • Collaborate with Product Managers, DI technical teams, and Technology teams to ensure seamless integration and delivery of DA assets.
  • Identify and address bottlenecks that impact asset value, and optimize the effectiveness of the asset
  • Develop a deep understanding of data product pipelines and data
  • Understand and support implementation of data product requirements
  • Communicate about data products with internal consumers
  • Participate and contribute to new data product initiatives

What Experience You Need

  • Bachelor’s degree in a related discipline; Master’s Degree strongly preferred
  • 5+ Years working in an enterprise environment with a strong understanding of data, models, and analytical tools in financial industry.
  • Commercial Acumen: Ability to understand and drive commercial outcomes for data.
  • Familiarity with Agile and other project management methods. Cloud certification and experience with cloud or on prem technologies, structured and unstructured data, streaming and reposed data.

  • Business Acumen: A strong understanding of business needs and the ability to translate technical concepts into business language
  • Leadership Skills: Ability to lead and influence others, driving strategic initiatives and delivering tangible outcomes.
