title: Product Owner-Administration and Permission Management
descriptionHtml:
At Anaplan, we are a team of innovators focused on optimizing business decision-making through our leading AI-infused scenario planning and analysis platform so our customers can outpace their competition and the market.

What unites Anaplanners across teams and geographies is our collective commitment to our customers’ success and to our Winning Culture.

Our customers rank among the who’s who in the Fortune 50. Coca-Cola, LinkedIn, Adobe, LVMH and Bayer are just a few of the 2,400+ global companies who rely on our best-in-class platform.

Our Winning Culture is the engine that drives our teams of innovators. We champion diversity of thought and ideas, we behave like leaders regardless of title, we are committed to achieving ambitious goals, and we love celebrating our wins – big and small.

Supported by operating principles of being strategy-led, values-based and disciplined in execution, you’ll be inspired, connected, developed and rewarded here. Everything that makes you unique is welcome; join us and let’s build what’s next - together!

Product Owner – Administration and Permission Management

 

Anaplan is looking for a passionate Product Owner to help drive the development of our next generation Planning and Decision Excellence platform. This person will be based in India and be instrumental in the execution of our product strategy. The role will focus on the Administration and Permission Management areas of the Anaplan Platform.

Applicants should have a Product Ownership background and ideally relevant experience with Anaplan or other equivalent solutions. Applicants would bring experience working with engineering teams to deliver products and solutions to the market, they would have to demonstrate that they will be able to learn a new market and understand the needs of our customers related to the management of SAAS platform for large enterprises.

 

CORE RESPONSIBILITIES

 

  • Work with the existing product team to define and drive the vision and roadmap for Platform Management features in Anaplan.
  • Work with the Product leadership, UX, Engineering and other cross-functional teams on roadmap and capacity planning
  • Work closely with engineering leaders and teams to execute on day-to-day development, taking direct ownership of the backlog.
  • Understand the market for Enterprise Software in general and Anaplan specifically. Be the voice of the customer while understanding the competitive Landscape. Be able to define and segment users of the Anaplan platform qualitatively and quantitatively.
  • Drive end-to-end experiences: writing user stories with clear acceptance criteria, working with UX to create prototypes for usability testing and research, working with engineering, documentation, support, and marketing to deliver quality experiences.
  • Effectively collaborate across global teams to create alignment between engineering teams and other product stakeholders.

 

REQUIREMENTS

 

  • Proven experience working as a Product Owner in a technology-driven environment, preferably with experience in SaaS or enterprise software companies.
  • Strong understanding of IT Governance, Separation of Duties, and the expectations of Enterprise IT and Security Teams with respect to SAAS Platforms.
  • Understanding of authentication and authorization practices in Enterprise IT (e.g. RBAC, Service Users, SSO, SAML, SCIM).
  • Strong understanding of typical API usage patterns within Enterprise IT
  • Domain knowledge of Anaplan solutions if possible
  • Strong understanding of the product management lifecycle and launching new products
  • Proficiency in gathering and analysing market and customer insights.
  • Ability to translate customer needs into actionable product requirements.
  • Experience working in an Agile development environment and familiarity with tools like Jira, Confluence, etc.
  • Experience in creating enablement documentation including technical & support style documents
  • Excellent organizational skills and experience in managing projects with multiple stakeholders to ensure successful product delivery
  • Highly analytical and able to troubleshoot issues quickly; candidates should be able to go from high level to low level very easily
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills to work effectively with cross-functional teams
  • Team player with the ability to work autonomously
  • Able and willing to work in a fast paced, quickly changing environment

Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB)

We believe attracting and retaining the best talent and fostering an inclusive culture strengthens our business. DEIB improves our workforce, enhances trust with our partners and customers, and drives business success. Build your career in a place where diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging aren’t just words on paper – this is what drives our innovation, it’s how we connect, and it contributes to what makes us a market leader. We believe in a hiring and working environment where all people are respected and valued, regardless of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, or any other aspect which makes people unique. We hire you for who you are, and we want you to bring your authentic self to work every day! 

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive equitable benefits and all privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.  

Fraud Recruitment Disclaimer  

It has come to our attention that fraudulent and fictitious job opportunities are being circulated on the Internet. Prospective candidates are being contacted by certain individuals, mainly through telephone calls, emails and correspondence, claiming they are representatives of Anaplan. The main purpose of these correspondences and announcements is to obtain privileged information from individuals.  

Anaplan does not:  

  • Extend offers to candidates without an extensive interview process with a member of our recruitment team and a hiring manager via video or in person.   
  • Send job offers via email. All offers are first extended verbally by a member of our internal recruitment team whenever possible and then followed up via written communication.  

All emails from Anaplan would come from an @anaplan.com email address. Should you have any doubts about the authenticity of an email, letter or telephone communication purportedly from, for, or on behalf of Anaplan, please send an email to people@anaplan.com before taking any further action in relation to the correspondence.

title: MDM Business Information Owner Product GBS
descriptionHtml:
Life tastes better with ice cream

With 19.000 expert ice cream colleagues and iconic brands like Wall’s, Cornetto and Ben & Jerry’s, loved in 76 countries, we are the world’s largest Ice Cream company leading the industry.

We create iconic ice cream brands that are part of everyday life, bringing moments of joy to millions of people around the world. Everybody loves ice cream. And as the world’s biggest pure‑play ice cream company, we have the scale and ambition to make a real difference.

What Truly Sets Us Apart Is How We Work.

We move fast and keep things simple. We turn ideas into action, trust people to take ownership, and work as one team to win together with integrity. Our culture is high‑performance, collaborative and focused on getting things done.

We’re curious and ready for what’s next. We embrace digital, use data to make better decisions, and keep learning, including how AI can help us work smarter and serve consumers better.

The role

This role will oversee continuous improvement on data design and governance, by acting as the recognized expert for data model, data processes, value sets, compliance and standardization requirements and controls in the area you are responsible for. You will bring strong data domain knowledge and expertise connecting with Domain Leads and Business Process Owners to design and maintain scalable, consistent and simplified data models, and connecting with IT to deliver on its execution and with the business to ensure the standardization and compliance controls are observed; You work will contribute directly to securing End to End data integrity cross processes and IT landscape through adequate data and process standardization.

What You'll Be Responsible For

  • Core Transformation role
  • With the demerger of TMICC from Unilever, the role will lead the mapping of existing roles of MDM with various partners, ensure himself/herself is fully understanding the needs of NEW MDG tool and new processes that are being built. Ensure the existing partner FTEs have SMEs for the new rulesets to land in their operations. Ensure testing starts as soon as possible. Also participate in data cleaning and data migration. TSA exit and transfer will be led by this role as well.
  • Secure approvals and change control process on data models and master data management processes
  • In steady state, support maintaining of the Data Landscape target information models - including master & transactional data-, regulatory and standardization controls, ensuring data quality and end-to-end consistency, including in cooperation with other BIEs; validating it with BPO/BPEs as part of the solution design, and with IT BA’s ensuring implementation as per design; documenting it using standard notations, templates and tools as defined within Enterprise Information Management.
  • Actively supporting the business transformation in data migration preparation and execution:
  • Support creation and maintenance of data quality rules/checks, reaching-out to relevant IT BA’s & data stewards for control definition and relevant measurement;
  • Support Data defect resolution: provides solutions / decisions / adjustment of cleansing rules and data model
  • Supporting the definition of the master data domain roadmap including requirements, design and governance, implementation and deployment of the Master Data Management (MDM) solution and processes.
  • Identifying and promoting continuous improvement opportunities to drive standardization design and adherence, including on data quality, by linking to business stakeholders, BPEs, data services and projects as well as with the IT community (including partner organizations)
  • Freeze scope for data migration with the business: Source systems and objects, Relevancy rules, source rules, data object ownership matrix completed by business; Responsible to document and validate these inputs in the data requirements specification document.
  • Design and validate value mapping with business, incl. transformation, harmonization rules (+reconciliation for finance) with support Data Migration Expert (DME).
  • Create data cleansing rules as needed by Domain Leads
  • Execute data cleansing based on rules by BIOs/Domain Leads and orphan data/construction, engaging with business and BPEs.
  • Support Data Migration Experts(DME) in upload file preparation: carries-out data quality check before load. Perform data qualification:
  • Analyze Pre- and post-load reports with the DME: resolve mismatch and exceptions, trigger BIE or BPE or IT BA for solution definition in their areas of responsibility
  • Act as defect log first reviewer to confirm allocation of defect to relevant owners
  • MDM Function set up
  • Establish and support scale the MDM team.
  • Support developing data models where applicable.
  • Lead MDM improvement initiatives in relevant domains
  • Ensure high-quality, accurate, and timely delivery of data management responsibilities.
  • Build capability within the team—hiring, upskilling, mentoring, and defining roles/workflows.
  • Transition Management
  • Lead the transition of Product or Material domain, to SAP MDG (greenfield implementation), transition of MDM processes and teams from global or regional units into the GBS.
  • Perform due diligence, risk analysis, and knowledge transfer planning.
  • Ensure seamless migration with minimal business disruption.
  • Align processes to the GBS operating model and standard tools.
  • Drive stakeholder management throughout transition cycles.
  • Stakeholder Management
  • Partner closely with global business leaders, GBS leadership, service line heads, and transformation teams.
  • Communicate performance insights, business outcomes, and improvement opportunities.
  • Build trusted relationships across levels and geographies.

We're Looking For Someone Who

  • Have a Master degree and 12+ years of working experience in the Customer/Vendor/Material/Product data domain in various MDM applications and related business processes.
  • Have proven expertise in implementing SAP MDG preferably greenfield
  • Have a proven track record in expert roles driving master data management solutions (requirements definition and consulting, data modeling, data requirements gathering, data governance, implementation and roll out of data models) and the ability to translate business requirements into data requirements and vice versa with process experts and IT business analysts. Understand the business impact, IT impact and data impact of the data and the solution alternatives
  • Have a solid experience in business and operational experience with idea to market and market-to-order processes. Knowledge of data and information generated and required for these processes.
  • Have a solid experience in the application areas of Enterprise Resource Planning (SAP MM, PP, QM, SD) and configure-price-quote, pricing, contract management, billing, license & entitlement management; Data migration, data quality and MDM solutions (SAP MDG); knowledge of data and information generated and used in these systems.
  • Are able to effectively present and communicate to senior stakeholders;
  • Have the right communications skill set to challenge and influence counterparts;
  • Have a broad understanding of data challenges in high tech manufacturing in terms of value chain processes and business models (product, system, software, service);
  • Good structure and communication skills: with the data migration team, with partner operations and with the business; Strong team player
  • Good analytical skills and experience in data profiling and analysis: Attention to details and determination to get things done in time and in quality
  • Hands on SAP MDG experience, e.g. Target source/mapping, data migration, data cleansing etc. for his/her data domain
  • Good knowledge and experience of business context: E2E processes and data model, data quality framework, data management operations for a given data domain is a plus
  • Certified consultant in domain specific CPQ and/or SAP modules e.g. MM/PP/SD/QM is a plus
  • Advanced excel capability will be very beneficial
  • Experience with (safe) agile ways of working, dev ops is a plus
  • Bachelors B.Tech must, masters preferred

What You'll Get

Alongside meaningful work and strong development, we offer a reward package that typically includes

  • Market-competitive pay and performance related rewards
  • Flexible ways of working
  • Support for health, wellbeing and life outside of work
  • Time off to rest and recharge
  • Ongoing learning and development opportunities

#TMICC

Why join us?

This is a place for people who are passionate about ice cream and are growth obsessed - both for the business and for themselves. People who act like an owner and drive our business end-to-end. People who are driven by success to deliver more than we ever thought we could!

You’ll thrive here if you value an inclusive culture, with low ego and hierarchy - and if you’re excited to continuously learn and challenge how we work, using digital, data, and new thinking to push us forward.

  • Roles with real accountability and visible impact
  • Free to move fast, experiment and challenge how things are done
  • Continuous learning and development as the business grows
  • Reward linked to performance and contribution.

Your career here is shaped by what you deliver, as you work across functions and markets and grow with the business.

Ready to build the future of Ice Cream?

If this sounds like the place where you'd thrive, we'd love to hear from you. Apply online and share your CV. We'll review your application and be in touch with the next steps.

If you are an individual with a disability and require assistance at any time during our recruitment process, please let your Talent Acquisition Partner know.

Additional Information

The Magnum Ice Cream Company is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We embrace diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work regardless of age, disability, gender identity, race, religion, sexual orientation, or any other protected characteristic.

title: Software Asset Management - Product Owner
descriptionHtml:
Position Overview

The Software Asset Management (SAM) Product Owner is responsible for defining, prioritizing, and driving the roadmap for the organization’s SAM capabilities. This role ensures that software assets across the enterprise are managed efficiently, cost-effectively, and in compliance with licensing and regulatory requirements. Acting as the bridge between business stakeholders, IT operations, procurement, cybersecurity, and vendors, the SAM Product Owner ensures that the SAM platform, processes, and data deliver maximum value. The SAM Product Owner will manage a team of SAM Analysts.

Key Responsibilities

Product Ownership & Strategy

  • Develop and maintain the SAM product vision, strategy, and roadmap aligned with IT, procurement, security, and financial objectives.
  • Translate business needs into clear epics, features, and user stories for development and operational teams.
  • Prioritize the backlog to ensure delivery of high-value features that support compliance, optimization, and lifecycle management.

SAM Process & Capability Leadership

  • Own and continuously improve SAM processes across the full software lifecycle: request → acquisition → deployment → usage → retirement.
  • Establish and monitor KPIs related to software compliance, cost avoidance, contract optimization, and asset lifecycle accuracy.
  • Partner with procurement and finance to support budgeting, forecasting, and contract renewals.

Stakeholder Management

  • Act as the primary point of contact for internal stakeholders regarding SAM capabilities, tooling, reporting, and data needs.
  • Collaborate with IT operations, cybersecurity, legal, and procurement to ensure SAM supports cross-functional objectives.
  • Communicate product progress, risks, and opportunities to leadership and key stakeholders.

Tooling & Data Management

  • Serve as the business owner for the SAM platform (Flexera/Snow)
  • Ensure data accuracy and integrity by defining requirements for discovery sources, integrations, and CMDB alignment.
  • Work with platform engineers to ensure system stability, implementation of new features, and lifecycle updates.

Compliance & Risk Management

  • Support and oversee software license compliance efforts, including audit readiness and defensive audit management.
  • Identify and mitigate risks associated with unauthorized, non-compliant, or under-licensed software usage.
  • Partner with security teams to ensure software usage aligns with cybersecurity standards and policies.

Value Optimization

  • Analyze usage data to drive software optimization initiatives (e.g., reducing dormant licenses, rationalizing applications, leveraging enterprise agreements).
  • Support vendor management activities through data insights, usage trends, and cost models.
  • Enable decision-making through clear dashboards and reporting for leadership and operational teams.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in IT, Business, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
  • 12+ years of proven experience in Software Asset Management, IT Asset management, or a related IT governance role.
  • Experience with directly managing a small team
  • Hands-on experience with SAM tools, preferably Flexera or Snow.
  • Solid understanding of software licensing models (Microsoft, Adobe, Oracle, SAP, IBM, etc.).
  • Demonstrated experience in product ownership, Agile methodologies, or backlog management.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO) or similar certification.
  • ITIL Foundation or IT Asset Management (e.g., CAMP, CSAM) certification.
  • Experience working in complex global environments with hybrid cloud, SaaS, and on prem technologies.
  • Strong analytical skills with experience building dashboards and reports (Power BI, Tableau, ServiceNow Performance Analytics).

Key Competencies

  • Strategic thinking with strong problem solving abilities.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Fluent in English language (verbal and written).
  • Ability to balance compliance, cost optimization, and business enablement.
  • Strong organizational skills and ability to lead cross-functional initiatives.
  • High attention to detail and a data-driven mindset

More information about NXP in India...

title: ServiceNow Product Owner
descriptionHtml:
Job Description

As the ServiceNow Product Owner, you will be accountable for defining and executing the product vision, roadmap, and governance of the ServiceNow platform across the enterprise. You will act as the owner for platform strategy, ensuring that ServiceNow delivers measurable business value, supports standardized ITSM processes, and enables future-ready capabilities such as CSDM adoption and AI-driven automation.

You will work closely with business stakeholders, architecture teams, and delivery organizations to prioritize demand, rationalize customizations, and drive the platform towards out-of-the-box (OOTB) best practices. This role is critical in ensuring platform scalability, data integrity (CMDB), and seamless integration across the IT ecosystem.

Operating in a global and cross-functional environment, you will balance strategic vision with execution discipline—enabling innovation while ensuring governance, stability, and operational excellence.

How You Will Contribute And What You Will Learn

  • Define and own the ServiceNow product strategy, and roadmap, ensuring alignment with enterprise digital and IT priorities
  • Drive demand prioritization and backlog management, optimizing delivery based on business value, risk, and strategic objectives
  • Champion adoption of out-of-the-box (OOTB) capabilities, reducing customization and minimizing technical debt
  • Establish and enforce platform governance, design standards, and architectural guardrails
  • Lead platform rationalization and standardization across ITSM, ITOM, and related service domains
  • Oversee end-to-end delivery of ServiceNow enhancements, releases, and platform capabilities
  • Act as the primary interface between business, IT, and delivery teams, ensuring alignment and execution clarity
  • Engage senior stakeholders to align priorities, drive decision-making, and articulate platform value
  • Drive continuous improvement using feedback, analytics, and usage insights
  • Enable effective cross-functional collaboration across internal teams, ecosystem partners, and vendors
  • Drive adoption of automation, AI-driven use cases, and intelligent workflows on the platform
  • Evaluate and integrate emerging capabilities (e.g., ITOM, AIOps, workflow automation) to enhance platform value
  • Support and enable enterprise-wide transformation initiatives leveraging the ServiceNow platform

Key Skills And Experience

You have:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related field
  • 15+ years of experience in IT / Telecom, with significant exposure to ServiceNow platform
  • Proven experience as a ServiceNow Product Owner / Platform Owner / Lead Architect in large enterprises
  • Strong understanding of ITSM, ITOM, CMDB, and CSDM frameworks
  • Experience in platform governance, roadmap planning, and demand prioritization
  • Proficiency in ServiceNow configuration, scripting, and integrations
  • Demonstrated ability to manage cross-functional, global teams and stakeholders
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills

Preferred:

  • Experience in driving platform standardization and OOTB transformation programs
  • Exposure to AI, automation, and digital workflow enablement within ServiceNow
  • Experience with Performance Analytics, Reporting, and value tracking frameworks
  • ServiceNow certifications
  • ITIL v4 certification

About Us

Advancing connectivity to secure a brighter world.

Nokia is a global leader in connectivity for the AI era. With expertise across fixed, mobile and transport networks, powered by the innovation of Nokia Bell Labs, we’re advancing connectivity to secure a brighter world.

Learn more about life at Nokia .

Our recruitment process

We act inclusively and respect the uniqueness of people. Our employment decisions are made regardless of race, color, national or ethnic origin, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law. We are committed to a culture of inclusion built upon our core value of respect.

If you’re interested in this role but don’t meet every listed requirement, we still encourage you to apply. Unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences enrich our teams, and you may be just the right candidate for this or another opportunity.

The length of the recruitment process may vary depending on the specific role's requirements. We strive to ensure a smooth and inclusive experience for all candidates. Discover more about the recruitment process at Nokia .

About The Team

Some of our benefits:

  • Flexible and hybrid working schemes
  • A minimum of 90 days of Maternity and Paternity Leave, with the option to return to work within a year following the birth or adoption of a child (based on eligibility)
  • Life insurance to all employees to provide peace of mind and financial security
  • Well-being programs to support your mental and physical health
  • Opportunities to join and receive support from Nokia Employee Resource Groups (NERGs)
  • Employee Growth Solutions to support your personalized career & skills development
  • Diverse pool of Coaches & Mentors to whom you have easy access
  • A learning environment which promotes personal growth and professional development - for your role and beyond

title: Product Owner
descriptionHtml:
About CleanHarbors

Clean Harbors Inc. (www.cleanharbors.com) is a NYSE listed US based $6.5 billion company. Clean Harbors was founded in 1980 near Boston by Mr. Alan S. McKim.

Everywhere industry meets environment, Clean Harbors is on-site, providing premier environmental, energy and industrial services. Clean Harbors employs a dedicated workforce of 25,000 employees and has over 750 service locations across the U.S., Canada and Mexico. Beyond addressing the environmental needs of its more than 300,000 customers, the Company has been on the front lines of addressing some of the largest emergency response events in North America of the past several decades including the BP Oil Spill in the Gulf of Mexico, the anthrax attacks in New York, the 2015 avian flu outbreak that devastated the poultry industry, Hurricanes Katrina, Rita and Sandy, and the oil pipeline breaks that affected the Yellowstone and Kalamazoo rivers, along with other major chemical releases into the environment.

Clean Harbors India has been strategically established as the Global Capability Center (GCC) to serve our parent company. We take pride in serving some of the most tech savvy business stakeholders at Clean Harbors. The GCC employees form part of our globally integrated teams that provide cutting-edge IT solutions and production support across platforms. Our shared services teams work seamlessly with their global counterparts in providing critical 24x7 support in various functions including Finance, HR, Procurement, IT and Operations. Our aggressive growth plans open significant career advancement opportunities for our employees.

Job Title: Product Owner – AI Enabled Product Development

Experience: 12+ Years with Min 5 years as Product Owner

Location: Hyderabad, Hybrid

Working Hours: 12.00pm to 9.00pm

Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with engineering teams to implement new features and improvements
  • Understands UX/UI components, wire-framing elements and design. Knowledge of Figma. Lucid, etc..
  • Apply prompt engineering techniques for wire-framing and design.
  • Excellent verbal/written communication skills and presenting ideas in group setting.
  • Prior experience with Atlassian products including JIRA and Confluence
  • Authors Epics and Stories with detailed acceptance criteria for enhancement requests that address stakeholder business problems
  • Works closely with delivery teams & business analysts to translate business requirements into workable product backlogs
  • Partners closely with the Scrum Masters on sprint planning, including prioritizing stories that have the highest business value and are aligned with enterprise standards and business roadmaps.
  • Use lean, iterative experiments and low-fidelity prototyping to find signal, validate hypothesis, and iterate before moving to scale
  • Collaborate with partners to define end-state architecture and drive secure, resilient, performant, and scalable technology solutions
  • Assess opportunities for reusing enterprise solutions and build new platforms with enterprise scalability in mind
  • Develop and maintain an appropriately prioritized backlog of user stories for implementation. A keen curiosity about emerging tools and technologies
  • Understands the enterprise IT processes and works closely with stakeholders to identify appropriate solutions to business problems.
  • Determines scope, estimates work effort, and determines duration of development activities.
  • Designs solutions to meet business requirements and works in close coordination with architects and delivery leads to drive solutions to production
  • Owns and updates the product vision and roadmaps.
  • Collaborates with the agile team to prepare the estimates for the user stories within the product backlog.
  • Conducts the formal review and acceptance of user stories implemented by the agile team within a sprint.
  • Drives the execution of user acceptance testing (UAT) activities with support from business and technology team members.
  • Provides daily support to the application / Product platform; including, integrations and administration

Qualifications

Required Skills

  • Proven experience as a Technology Product Owner in developing tech platforms for underwriting, and policy lifecycle processes or Insurtech, with a solid understanding of insurance products, processes, and customer needs.
  • Demonstrate ability to combine deep business and product knowledge with technical know-how
  • Strong knowledge of Agile methodologies and experience working within cross-functional Agile teams.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders at various levels.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a focus on delivering user-centered products.
  • Ability to independently plan deliverables and coordinate with team-members.
  • Team player - friendly, communicative, open, honest, thoughtful, and committed.
  • Ability to work cooperatively with others, sharing ideas, collaborating and ultimately, putting team goals first.
  • Experience mentoring and coaching others
  • Demonstrated documentation experience in creating rich content that explains business requirements – usage of various documentation tools is a must

Recommended

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Software or other Technical degree.
  • 10+ experience in IT field, 5+ years minimum working as a Product Owner in IT field, with at least 3+ years as Technology Product Owner.
  • Demonstrated experience with building software products using agile methodologies

title: Senior Staff Technical Product Owner
descriptionHtml:
Job Description Summary

Job Description

We are building a secure, compliant, and highly reliable healthcare data platform that transports and transforms clinical and operational data from hospital on‑premises environments to the cloud. As a Sr. Staff Technical Product Owner, you will own the product vision, roadmap, and outcomes for end‑to‑end data movement, interoperability, and governance—working across global product managers in multiple healthcare sub‑segments to deliver interoperable, scalable, and cost‑efficient data capabilities.

What You’ll Do (Key Responsibilities)

  • Own vision & roadmap
    • Translate organizational strategy into a platform‑level multi‑release roadmap with clear value milestones and measurable outcomes.
    • Continuously capture Voice of Customer (VoC) from catching programs and adjust prioritization and scope to maximize impact.
  • Backlog leadership
    • Author and maintain Epics, Features, and User Stories with acceptance criteria; ensure traceability to business outcomes and regulatory/compliance needs.
    • Lead backlog grooming, PI planning, and cross‑program dependency management (SAFe or equivalent).
  • Bridge product & engineering
    • Act as the primary interface between global product managers and engineering leads, ensuring scope clarity, non‑functional requirements (performance, reliability, security), and delivery quality.
    • Drive design‑to‑value decisions across ingestion, streaming, API exposure, and data storage layers in future.
  • Healthcare interoperability & data standards
    • Define patterns for HL7 v2.x, FHIR - Mapping/translation
    • Guide implementation choices for integration engines (e.g., Mirth/NextGen Connect, Cloverleaf, Rhapsody) and schema governance.
  • Secure & compliant data movement (on‑prem → cloud)
    • Own product requirements for connectivity (AWS Direct Connect, Site‑to‑Site VPN, SD‑WAN, private links), data in motion (TLS 1.2/1.3, mTLS, certificate rotation), and data at rest (KMS/HSM encryption, key rotation).
    • Define AuthN/AuthZ strategies (OIDC/OAuth2, SAML, RBAC/ABAC, least privilege) and secrets management.
    • Ensure adherence to HIPAA, HITRUST, SOC 2, ISO 27001, and regional privacy laws (e.g., GDPR).
  • Streaming & data platform architecture
    • Shape the streaming roadmap using Kafka (brokers, topics, partitions, consumer groups, schema registry, Avro/Protobuf), Kafka Connect, and CDC pipelines or any similar technology
    • Partner with architects on scalable ingestion, schema evolution, replay, dead‑letter handling, and observability (OpenTelemetry, metrics, tracing, logs).
  • AWS platform delivery
    • Define requirements and guardrails for AWS services such as S3, MSK (or self‑managed Kafka), Glue, EKS, Lambda, API Gateway, PrivateLink, CloudWatch, KMS, Secrets Manager.
    • Drive reliability goals (SLOs/SLAs, RTO/RPO), disaster recovery patterns, and multi‑account/multi‑region design as needed.
  • Cloud cost optimization (FinOps)
    • Lead cost‑to‑serve modeling and reduction initiatives: right‑sizing, instance families compression/partitioning, autoscaling, and data egress minimization.
    • Establish cost dashboards, budgets, and per‑feature cost accountability.
  • Cybersecurity & privacy
    • Stay current with cybersecurity best practices (zero‑trust, network segmentation, vulnerability management, threat modelling, security testing, SBOM where applicable).
    • Champion privacy‑by‑design, data minimization, de‑identification/pseudonymization where appropriate.
What You’ll Bring (Required Qualifications)

  • Experience: 12–15+ years in product management/ownership or platform leadership, with 5+ years focused on data platforms/streaming and 3+ years in healthcare data interoperability.
  • Deep technical fluency in:
    • Streaming with Kafka (clusters, partitioning strategy, throughput/latency tuning, schema registry).
    • Data security: encryption at rest/in transit, AuthN/AuthZ (OIDC/OAuth2/SAML), RBAC/ABAC, secrets management.
    • AWS core data & networking services; secure connectivity from on‑prem to cloud (Direct Connect, VPN, private connectivity).
    • Cybersecurity controls and compliance frameworks relevant to healthcare (HIPAA/HITRUST/SOC 2).
  • Healthcare standards: hands‑on with HL7 v2, FHIR
  • Roadmap & execution: proven track record translating vision into incremental deliveries; ownership of Epics/Features/Stories and measurable outcomes.
  • Cross‑functional leadership: success aligning multiple global product managers and engineering teams in a highly dynamic environment.
  • Cloud cost reduction: demonstrable wins lowering run‑rate and egress costs, optimizing storage/compute, and implementing FinOps practices.
  • Communication: excellent written/verbal skills with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to non‑technical stakeholders and vice‑versa.
  • Hands on experience in Product Management using Gen AI tooling
Nice To Have (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Experience with integration engines (e.g., Mirth/NextGen Connect, Cloverleaf, Rhapsody), and EMR/vendor ecosystems (Epic, Oracle Health/Cerner, Meditech, etc.).
  • Knowledge of data governance & cataloguing (e.g., AWS Lake Formation, Glue Data Catalog), lineage, DQ frameworks, and PHI/PII handling patterns.
  • Familiarity with event‑driven and API‑first architectures (REST/gRPC), Idempotency, Exactly‑once/At‑least‑once semantics.
  • Observability tooling (CloudWatch, Datadog, Splunk,Promethesu, Graffana) and SRE practices (error budgets, SLOs).

Inclusion and Diversity

GE HealthCare is an Equal Opportunity Employer where inclusion matters. title: Senior Manager, Product Marketing
descriptionHtml:
Why this role exists


Most product marketing functions react to launches. We're building JustCall's PMM function to drive them - shaping how the market understands what we build, why we win, and where we're headed before the competition figures it out.


We are looking a Senior Manager of Product Marketing who can sit across the table from a sales leader, a product manager, or a prospect - and walk out with a sharper narrative, a tighter battlecard, and a GTM motion that converts faster because the message finally lands. Someone who lives at the intersection of market insight and revenue outcome - and treats both as personal accountability.


What you'll actually do


  • Own positioning, messaging, and competitive intelligence for JustCall - ensuring every customer touchpoint communicates why we win, not just what we do.
  • Build and maintain a structured competitive intelligence system - alerts, battlecards, market tracking frameworks - that keeps Sales and Product ahead of the market.
  • Drive GTM launches end to end - from market narrative to sales enablement to adoption tracking - in close partnership with Product, Sales, and Growth.
  • Partner directly with Sales in outbound and enterprise motions - shaping customer conversations, win-loss narratives, and objection handling through sharp positioning.
  • Connect PMM initiatives to pipeline generation, win rates, feature adoption, and revenue outcomes - not just launch metrics.
  • Simplify complex product and AI capabilities into compelling customer narratives that resonate across buyer personas and sales stages.
  • Drive adoption, expansion, and retention initiatives alongside Product, Growth, and CS - treating the full customer lifecycle as PMM territory.
  • Build scalable PMM playbooks, launch frameworks, and sales enablement processes that improve with every cycle.


What we're looking for


  • 7-12 years across Product Marketing, GTM Strategy, Growth, or related SaaS functions.
  • Strong experience working closely with Sales in outbound or enterprise SaaS environments where PMM meaningfully influences revenue outcomes.
  • Deep understanding of positioning, messaging, competitive intelligence, product launches, and sales enablement.
  • Strong commercial mindset - you connect PMM work directly to pipeline, win rates, adoption, and business growth.
  • Highly proactive and market-aware - you track competitor products, packaging, pricing, and messaging changes constantly.
  • Strong storytelling and communication skills - you simplify complex product and AI concepts into narratives that resonate with buyers.
  • High ownership and builder mindset - you operate independently, influence cross-functional teams, and don't wait for perfect briefs.
  • Comfortable using data, customer insights, and market signals to refine positioning and GTM strategy.


Edges that help


  • You've built structured competitive intelligence systems from scratch - not just maintained a slide deck of competitor screenshots.
  • You've directly influenced Sales strategy, customer conversations, and win-loss outcomes through positioning and market insights.
  • You have deep exposure to AI SaaS, platform products, or technically complex B2B environments - you know how to market what's hard to explain.
  • You've built scalable PMM playbooks and launch frameworks that outlasted your involvement and improved over time.
  • You can independently identify market opportunities and positioning gaps - and move on them without being asked.


How we work


  • Outcomes over output. We measure PMM impact by win rates, pipeline influence, feature adoption, and competitive displacement - not decks delivered.
  • High ownership from day one - you'll build the PMM function, not inherit a finished one.
  • Fast cycles, real ambiguity, and the expectation that you bring both market instinct and execution rigor to everything you touch.
  • Competitive pay tied to the revenue narrative you shape and the GTM outcomes you drive.


The bigger picture


JustCall is SaaS Labs' flagship product - used by 6,000+ businesses across 70+ countries to run their customer conversations. We're backed by Peak XV and Base10 Partners, have crossed $40M ARR, and are building toward $100M with the team, the product, and the infrastructure to get there.


If this is the role you've been waiting to find - let's talk.


SaaS Labs takes pride in being an equal opportunity employer. We believe diverse teams build better products, which is why we're committed to making hiring or any employment decision regardless of race, colour, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic.

title: R&D Technical Product Owner
descriptionHtml:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This Position reports to:

R&D Department Lead




Your role and responsibilities:

In this role, you will have the opportunity to initiate and drive technology, software, product, and/or solution development using in-depth technical expertise in a specific area. Each day, you will act as the first point of contact in Research and Development (R&D) for in-depth product or technology-related issues. You will also showcase your expertise by supporting strategic corporate technology management and future product/software/solution architecture.

The work model for the role is:

This role is contributing to the Motion Business High Power Division in Bangalore,India

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Responsible as a release manager for virtual drives, ensuring high quality releases and developing release process.
  • Responsible as Product Owner for the team, managing the Product, System, Architecture, Integration and Testing Requirements for the product under development.
  • Responsible to communicate product vision and ambition (from product mgt), team delivery and quality performance.
  • Acts as a link between team and global roles (product mgt, program/project mgt), external vendors or other teams.
  • Responsible for the product/software requirements planning and clarifications to understand the product development requirements and prepares the requirements for the team on system/product requirements, covering all aspects of software development cycle of design, coding, Integration, unit testing, system integration and continuous integration of software modules in line with the quality management system.
  • Responsible for defining the acceptance criteria for all requirements covering design and development of software modules, module integration, unit testing, system integration and system testing.
  • Supports management on people management topics and possibly later take the role of a People Manager role.

Qualifications for the role:

  • Graduate/Master’s in engineering with 12 - 14 year’s experience in software application/product design and development with understanding of software development life cycle process and tools.
  • Minimum 4 years of experience with product ownership, skill set also towards non-technical work - Product management and people management.
  • Strong understanding and expertise on Requirements management, Integration and Code Repositiory management tools like GiT.
  • Strong Expertise in the Embedded application layer development, Embedded System Design and Development.
  • Experience in Drives / VFD Simulation programming & Virtualization of embedded systems.
  • Good proficiency and expertise in Embedded System Integration, System verification and continuous integration.
  • Expertise on Coding - Embedded C , C++.
  • Strong understanding and knowledge of SCRUM and Agile Principle with Certification on Agile Product Owner role.

More about us :

ABB Motion provides pioneering technology, products, solutions and related services to industrial customers to increase energy efficiency, improve safety and reliability, and maintain precise control over processes. The portfolio includes motors, generators and drives for a wide range of applications in all industrial sectors.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

Recruitment Fraud Warning

ABB never asks for payment from job applicants. All genuine job offers follow a formal application and interview process.

View current job openings and apply at: https://careers.abb/global/en/home

For more information, read our full fraud warning notice at: https://global.abb/group/en/careers/how-to-apply/fraud-warning

title: Senior Staff Product Owner
descriptionHtml:
Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.

Who We Are

In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!

We believe collaboration thrives in person. That’s why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it’s needed. This model supports real-time problem-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes.

Job Summary

The Senior Staff Product Owner (PO) is a member of the R&D development team responsible for bridging the gap between market requirements, as defined by Product Management, and the technical solution. This role owns the developed solution throughout the entire development lifecycle, from planning and development to a successful customer release. The PO works closely with the Development Team, Product Management, Professional Services, Technical Writers, and R&D management.

Key Responsibilities

  • Produce valuable content for our customers.
  • Own the product backlog by deconstructing large features into smaller pieces, then defining and prioritizing them to compose a releasable product.
  • Act as the central focal point for all internal and external parties on how the product works, its capabilities, and the effects of any changes.
  • Analyze product business requirements and produce a functional design.
  • Utilize deep knowledge of the product and its customer use cases to collaborate with R&D, explain requirements, and answer functional questions.
  • Lead large, high-visibility projects that involve multiple development teams.

Qualifications

  • 5-8 years of experience as a functional analyst, product owner, business analyst, or in product management within the software industry.
  • BTech, or BE in Computer Science/Engineering, or 3-5 years of hands-on experience in software development.
  • Deep expertise in Digital Identity and Access Management (IAM), including protocols (OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SAML 2.0), MFA, SCIM, SSO, federation, and access control models (RBAC/ABAC/PBAC/ReBAC).
  • Proven technical skills and self-learning ability, capable of thoroughly understanding the functional and technical aspects of IAM domains.
  • Experience in writing functional designs.
  • Proven Agile experience.
  • Proven management skills.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills.
  • Proactive, highly motivated individual with a serious work ethic and goal-oriented approach.
  • Innovative 'out of the box' thinker.
  • Experience with an AI-First strategy for initiatives.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Previous experience in a pre-sale or post-sale role.
  • Information security experience.

Our Commitment

We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at accommodations@paloaltonetworks.com.

Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Is role eligible for Immigration Sponsorship? No. Please note that we will not sponsor applicants for work visas for this position.
